<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#07569f" />
  <title>Organigrama Organizacional JOMAR</title>
  <style>:root{--b950:#082b4c;--b900:#073b6b;--b800:#07569f;--b700:#146bb5;--b50:#f4f8fc;--red:#e5233f;--ink:#17324a;--muted:#60758a;--line:#d8e3ed;--canvas:#edf3f8;--gold:#e3a008;--green:#16845b;--shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(8,43,76,.13)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{width:100%;height:100%;margin:0;overflow:hidden}body{font-family:Inter,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--canvas)}button,input{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}.app{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;grid-template-rows:76px 46px 1fr}
.tabbar{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:0 24px;z-index:29}.tab-btn{height:34px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--b50);color:var(--b900);border-radius:9px;padding:0 16px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.01em}.tab-btn:hover{background:#eaf2fa}.tab-btn.active{background:var(--b800);border-color:var(--b800);color:#fff}
.print-view{min-height:0;overflow:auto;background:var(--canvas);padding:26px 30px 60px}
.pv-head{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--b900),var(--b800));color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:20px 24px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-bottom:18px}
.pv-head .eyebrow-pv{color:#bcd8ef;font-size:10px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 4px}
.pv-head h2{margin:0;font-size:21px}.pv-head .director-line{margin:6px 0 16px;font-size:12.5px;color:#dbeaf6}.pv-head .director-line b{color:#fff}
.pv-label{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#bcd8ef;margin:0 0 8px}
.pv-cards{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.pv-card{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:9px;padding:8px 12px;min-width:150px}
.pv-card.vacant{border-style:dashed;opacity:.8}
.pv-card .role{font-size:9px;font-weight:850;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.85}
.pv-card .name{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:650;margin-top:3px}
.pv-controls{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 20px;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:18px;align-items:flex-end;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(8,43,76,.05)}
.pv-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.pv-field label{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--b950)}
.pv-field select{height:38px;border:1px solid #cbd9e5;border-radius:9px;padding:0 12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink);min-width:260px;background:#fff}
.pv-controls .pv-actions{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:8px}
.pv-zone-block{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 20px;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(8,43,76,.05)}
.pv-zone-block h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:14px;color:var(--b950)}
.pv-zone-block .zone-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px}
.pv-zone-tree{position:relative}
.pv-zone-manager-row{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:26px}
.pv-zone-nodes{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:16px;justify-content:center;position:relative}
.pv-zone-nodes::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-26px;left:50%;width:2px;height:26px;background:#c3d3e2;transform:translateX(-1px)}
.pv-node-box{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--b800);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 14px;text-align:center;min-width:170px;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(8,43,76,.08)}
.pv-node-box .role{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:850;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--b900)}
.pv-node-box .name{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:650;margin-top:3px;color:var(--ink)}
.pv-node-box.vacant{border-style:dashed;color:var(--red)}
.pv-node-box.vacant .name{color:var(--red)}
.pv-node-box .hc-line{margin-top:4px;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--b900);background:var(--b50);border-radius:6px;padding:2px 6px;display:inline-block}
.pv-manager-card .hc-line{margin-top:5px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;opacity:.92}
.pv-store-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:6px}
.pv-store-logo{height:34px;object-fit:contain}
.pv-print-btn{height:36px;border:1px solid #cbd9e5;border-radius:9px;background:#fff;color:var(--b900);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;padding:0 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.pv-print-btn:hover{background:var(--b50)}
#pvHcBtn.active{background:var(--b800);border-color:var(--b800);color:#fff}
.pv-store-page{width:1000px;max-width:100%;margin:0 auto;transform-origin:top center}
.pv-search-field{min-width:280px}
@page{size:landscape}
@media print{
  *{-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact!important;print-color-adjust:exact!important;color-adjust:exact!important}
  html,body{overflow:visible!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important}
  .header,.tabbar,.sidebar,.pv-controls,.pv-head,#pvZoneBlock{display:none!important}
  .print-view{overflow:visible!important;padding:0!important;background:#fff!important}
  .app{display:block!important;height:auto!important;overflow:visible!important}
  .workspace,.canvas-shell{display:none!important}
  .pv-store{box-shadow:none!important;border:none!important;padding:10px!important}
  .pv-print-btn{display:none!important}
  .pv-store-page{width:100%!important;transform:none!important}
  .pv-store-break{page-break-after:always;break-after:page}
  .pv-page-break-before{page-break-before:always;break-before:page}
  .pv-store{display:block!important}
  #pvStoreBox,#pvContent,.print-view{display:block!important;height:auto!important;overflow:visible!important}
  .pv-role-box{width:150px!important;font-size:10px!important;break-inside:avoid;page-break-inside:avoid}
  .pv-role-box ul li{padding:3px 8px!important}
  .pv-role-groups{gap:6px!important}
  .pv-manager-row{margin-bottom:14px!important}
  .pv-store-page{padding:0!important}
}
.pv-store{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:24px 26px 30px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(8,43,76,.05)}
.pv-store-title{font-size:12px;color:var(--red);font-weight:850;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:2px}
.pv-store-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:24px}
.pv-tree{position:relative}
.pv-manager-row{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:30px}
.pv-manager-card{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--b900),var(--b800));color:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 22px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(8,43,76,.2);min-width:210px}
.pv-manager-card .role{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase}
.pv-manager-card .name{font-size:13px;margin-top:3px}
.pv-role-groups{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;position:relative}

.pv-role-box{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--b800);border-radius:10px;width:190px;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(8,43,76,.08);overflow:hidden;align-self:flex-start}
.pv-role-box .head{background:var(--b800);color:#fff;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;text-align:center;padding:8px 10px;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px}
.pv-role-box .head .chev{font-size:9px;transition:transform .15s}
.pv-zone-note{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;font-style:italic}
.pv-role-box.collapsed .head .chev{transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.pv-role-box ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:10px 14px}
.pv-role-box.collapsed ul{display:none}
.pv-role-box li{font-size:11.5px;padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #e2e9f0}
.pv-role-box li:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.pv-role-box li.vacant-name{color:var(--red);font-weight:800}
.pv-empty{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;padding:20px;text-align:center}

.pv-export-modal{width:460px;max-width:92vw;max-height:86vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow-y:auto}
.pv-export-cats{display:flex;gap:16px;margin:6px 0 16px;padding:12px;background:var(--b50);border-radius:10px}
.pv-multiselect{position:relative}
.pv-multiselect-btn{width:100%;height:38px;text-align:left;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid #cbd9e5;border-radius:9px;background:#fff;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
.pv-multiselect-panel{display:none;position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 4px);left:0;right:0;max-height:220px;overflow-y:auto;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(8,43,76,.18);z-index:20;padding:6px}
.pv-multiselect-panel.open{display:block}
.pv-multiselect-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:7px;font-size:11.5px;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.2}
.pv-multiselect-item input{width:14px;height:14px;flex:0 0 14px;margin:0}
.pv-multiselect-item:hover{background:var(--b50)}
.pv-multiselect-all{font-weight:800;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:4px}
.pv-export-cat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:750;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
.pv-export-cat input{width:15px;height:15px}
.pv-export-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:4px 0 8px}
.pv-export-list{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:6px;margin-bottom:14px;max-height:340px}

.pv-export-item:hover{background:var(--b50)}
.pv-export-item input{width:15px;height:15px;flex:0 0 auto}
.pv-export-item .nm{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.pv-export-item .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;margin-left:4px}

.pv-cover-logo{height:46px;object-fit:contain;margin-bottom:26px}
.pv-cover-title{font-size:22px;font-weight:850;color:var(--b950);margin:0 0 4px}
.pv-cover-zone{font-size:17px;font-weight:850;color:var(--b800);margin:2px 0 14px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.pv-cover-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 26px}
.pv-cover-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;table-layout:fixed}
.pv-cover-table th{text-align:left;color:#70859a;font-size:9.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--b800);overflow-wrap:break-word}
.pv-cover-table td{padding:9px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow-wrap:break-word}
.pv-cover-table tr:nth-child(even){background:var(--b50)}
.pv-cover-table.pv-cover-table--sm{font-size:10.5px}
.pv-cover-table.pv-cover-table--sm th{padding:6px 8px;font-size:8.5px}
.pv-cover-table.pv-cover-table--sm td{padding:6px 8px}
.pv-cover-table.pv-cover-table--xs{font-size:9.5px}
.pv-cover-table.pv-cover-table--xs th{padding:5px 6px;font-size:7.5px}
.pv-cover-table.pv-cover-table--xs td{padding:4.5px 6px}
.pv-cover-table.pv-cover-table--xxs{font-size:8.5px}
.pv-cover-table.pv-cover-table--xxs th{padding:4px 5px;font-size:7px}
.pv-cover-table.pv-cover-table--xxs td{padding:3.5px 5px}
.pv-cover-total{margin-top:20px;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--b950);text-align:right}
.node-card{width:222px;min-height:104px;position:relative;background:#fff;border:1px solid #bfd0de;border-radius:13px;box-shadow:0 8px 23px rgba(8,43,76,.13);padding:14px 14px 12px 17px;color:var(--ink);transition:.15s;cursor:pointer;overflow:visible}.node-card:hover{border-color:#6f9bc0;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(8,43,76,.18)}.node-card.focused{border:2px solid var(--red);padding:13px 13px 11px 16px}.node-card.selected{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(227,160,8,.22),0 12px 28px rgba(8,43,76,.18)}.node-card.spotlight{border:2px solid var(--red);padding:13px 13px 11px 16px;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(229,35,63,.13),0 15px 32px rgba(8,43,76,.2)}.node-card.audit-alias{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#f2f8fd)}.node-card.audit-alias:after{content:"VISTA DE AUDITORÍA";position:absolute;right:10px;top:-9px;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--b900);color:#fff;font-size:7px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.06em}.node-card.vacant{border:2px dashed #d7495f;background:#fff7f8}.node-card.suspended{border-color:#e2bd66}.node-card.placeholder-slot{border:2px dashed #9aa7b5;background:#f4f6f8;opacity:.85}.node-card.placeholder-slot .card-role,.node-card.placeholder-slot .card-name{color:#70859a;font-style:italic}.node-card.department-root{background:linear-gradient(145deg,var(--b900),var(--b800));border:0;color:#fff;padding-top:17px}
.node-card.familia-group{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#5b1220,#33090f);border:0;color:#fff;padding-top:17px}
.node-card.familia-group:after{content:"GRUPO · NO ES UNA PERSONA";position:absolute;right:10px;top:-9px;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-size:6.6px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.05em;white-space:nowrap}
.familia-group .card-role,.familia-group .card-name,.familia-group .card-meta{color:#fff}
.familia-group .card-name{font-style:italic;opacity:.85}.card-rail{position:absolute;left:0;top:12px;bottom:12px;width:4px;border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;background:var(--b700)}.vacant .card-rail{background:var(--red)}.suspended .card-rail{background:var(--gold)}.card-role{color:var(--b900);font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.32;font-weight:850;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.015em;max-height:34px;overflow:hidden}.department-root .card-role{color:#fff;font-size:13.5px}.card-name{margin-top:6px;color:#587087;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:650;max-height:30px;overflow:hidden}.vacant .card-name{color:#bd1831;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.08em}.department-root .card-name{color:#d6e8f7}.card-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;margin-top:8px;color:#7890a5;font-size:8.5px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.department-root .card-meta{color:#d3e4f3}.expand-node{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-14px;transform:translateX(-50%);height:28px;min-width:28px;border-radius:15px;border:2px solid #fff;background:var(--b800);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(8,43,76,.23);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:3px;padding:0 7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:850}.spotlight .expand-node{background:var(--red)}.expand-node:hover{background:var(--red)}.link{fill:none;stroke:#a9bfd2;stroke-width:1.6}.link.focus-link{stroke:var(--b700);stroke-width:2.3}
.empty-state{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;place-items:center;pointer-events:none}.empty-state.open{display:grid}.empty-card{text-align:center;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:24px;max-width:360px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.empty-card h3{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--b950)}.empty-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}.toast{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:72px;transform:translate(-50%,12px);z-index:100;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--b950);color:#fff;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:.2s}.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media(max-width:1120px){.status-breakdown{gap:7px}}
body.public-mode .suspended-status,body.public-mode .vacant-status{display:none}
.rh-login-overlay{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(8,43,76,.45);z-index:200;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.rh-login-overlay.open{display:flex}
.rh-login-modal{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:26px 28px 28px;width:340px;max-width:92vw;box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative}
.rh-login-modal h3{margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--b950);font-size:18px}
.rh-login-modal p{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4}
.rh-login-modal .pv-field{margin-bottom:12px}
.rh-login-modal .pv-field input{width:100%;height:40px;border:1px solid #cbd9e5;border-radius:9px;padding:0 12px;font-size:13px}
.rh-login-close{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;width:28px;height:28px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:#eef4f8;color:#577087}
.rh-login-error{display:none;color:#bb1831;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin:-4px 0 12px}
.rh-login-error.show{display:block}
.plantilla-view{min-height:0;overflow:auto;background:var(--canvas);padding:26px 30px 60px}
.plantilla-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:22px 24px;margin-bottom:20px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(8,43,76,.05);max-width:720px}
.plantilla-card h3{margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--b950);font-size:15px}
.plantilla-card p{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5}
.plantilla-card .warn{background:#fff7e8;border:1px solid #f0d9a6;color:#7a5a12;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;margin-top:12px}
.plantilla-card a.dl-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--b800);color:#fff;border-radius:9px;padding:0 16px;height:40px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none}
.plantilla-card a.dl-link:hover{background:var(--b900)}
.plantilla-card .no-file{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;font-style:italic}
.plantilla-card.wide{max-width:none}
.plantilla-card a.dl-link.orange{background:var(--gold)}
.plantilla-card a.dl-link.orange:hover{background:#c98a06}
.jomar-head{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:10px;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px}
.jomar-head .jomar-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.jomar-filter{height:36px;border:1px solid #cbd9e5;border-radius:9px;padding:0 12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink);min-width:240px;background:#fff}
.jomar-table-wrap{max-height:480px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px}
table.jomar-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11.5px}
table.jomar-table thead th{position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--b800);color:#fff;text-align:left;padding:8px 10px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
th.jomar-sortable{cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
th.jomar-sortable:hover{background:#003a75}
table.jomar-table tbody td{padding:6px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}
table.jomar-table tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:#f7fafc}
.jomar-count{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px}
@media(max-width:760px){.app{grid-template-rows:66px 1fr}.header{padding:0 13px}.brand img{width:112px;height:42px}.brand-line,.title-wrap p,.header-meta{display:none}.title-wrap h1{font-size:15px}.workspace{grid-template-columns:0 1fr}.workspace:not(.sidebar-closed) .sidebar{transform:translateX(0)}.sidebar{position:absolute;top:66px;bottom:0;left:0;width:344px;max-width:91vw;transform:translateX(-105%);transition:transform .25s;box-shadow:14px 0 38px rgba(8,43,76,.22)}.toolbar{left:8px;right:8px;top:8px}.tool-btn{padding:0 10px}.toolbar-divider{display:none}.detail{left:11px;right:11px;top:70px;bottom:11px;width:auto}.helper{display:none}.legend{left:11px;right:auto;bottom:10px}.legend-item:nth-child(3){display:none}}
</style>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7/dist/d3.min.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
<div class="app">
  <header class="header">
    <div class="brand">
      <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Grupo JOMAR" />
      <div class="brand-line"></div>
      <div class="title-wrap"><h1>Organigrama Organizacional</h1><p>Estructura por posición · Consulta institucional</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="header-meta"><span class="update-date">Actualizado: 9 septiembre 2026</span><div class="source-chip"><span class="source-dot"></span><span id="sourceLabel">Cargando Excel oficial…</span></div></div>
  </header>

  <div class="tabbar">
    <button class="tab-btn active" id="tabBtnOrg" onclick="showTab('org')">Organigrama</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" id="tabBtnPrint" onclick="showTab('print')">Vista Impresión</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" id="tabBtnRhOrg" onclick="showTab('rhorg')" style="display:none">Organigrama RH</button>
    <button class="tab-btn" id="tabBtnPlantilla" onclick="showTab('plantilla')" style="display:none">Plantilla Operativa</button>
    <span style="margin-left:auto"></span>
    <button class="tab-btn" id="rhLoginBtn" onclick="rhOpenLogin()">Iniciar Sesión RH</button>
    <span id="rhUserBadge" style="display:none;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:var(--b900);padding:0 6px">✓ <span id="rhUserName"></span> <button class="tab-btn" style="height:26px;padding:0 8px;margin-left:6px" onclick="rhLogout()">Salir</button></span>
  </div>

  <div class="rh-login-overlay" id="rhLoginOverlay">
    <div class="rh-login-modal">
      <button class="rh-login-close" onclick="rhCloseLogin()">×</button>
      <h3>Acceso RH</h3>
      <p>Este acceso es solo para personal autorizado de Recursos Humanos.</p>
      <div class="pv-field"><label for="rhUserInput">Usuario</label><input id="rhUserInput" type="text" autocomplete="off"></div>
      <div class="pv-field"><label for="rhPassInput">Contraseña</label><input id="rhPassInput" type="password" autocomplete="off"></div>
      <div id="rhLoginError" class="rh-login-error"></div>
      <button class="upload-btn" onclick="rhSubmitLogin()">Entrar</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="rh-login-overlay" id="pvExportOverlay">
    <div class="rh-login-modal pv-export-modal">
      <button class="rh-login-close" onclick="pvCloseExportModal()">×</button>
      <h3>Exportar varias</h3>
      <p>¿Qué deseas exportar? Puedes elegir una, dos o las tres categorías — cada una se descarga como un PDF separado.</p>
      <div class="pv-export-cats">
        <label class="pv-export-cat"><input type="checkbox" id="pvCatSucursal" checked onchange="pvToggleExportCategory()"> Zona / Sucursal</label>
        <label class="pv-export-cat"><input type="checkbox" id="pvCatCorporativo" onchange="pvToggleExportCategory()"> Corporativo</label>
        <label class="pv-export-cat"><input type="checkbox" id="pvCatCedis" onchange="pvToggleExportCategory()"> CEDIS</label>
        <label class="pv-export-cat"><input type="checkbox" id="pvCatDirecciones" onchange="pvToggleExportCategory()"> Direcciones</label>
      </div>

      <div class="pv-field"><label for="pvExportSearch">Buscar por sucursal o departamento <span style="font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)">(Enter para seleccionar las que coincidan)</span></label><input id="pvExportSearch" type="text" placeholder="Ej. Puerta del Sol, Recursos Humanos…" oninput="pvFilterExportList()" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){event.preventDefault();pvSelectFilteredByText()}"></div>

      <div id="pvExportSucursalPanel">
        <div class="pv-field"><label for="pvZoneRangeSelect">Filtrar por Gerente de Zona (opcional)</label>
          <select id="pvZoneRangeSelect" onchange="pvApplyZoneRangeFilter()"><option value="">Todos los gerentes</option></select>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-field"><label>Filtrar por Zona (opcional, elige varias)</label>
          <div class="pv-multiselect" id="pvZoneCodeMulti">
            <button type="button" class="pv-multiselect-btn" id="pvZoneCodeBtn" onclick="pvToggleZoneCodeDropdown()">Todas las zonas</button>
            <div class="pv-multiselect-panel" id="pvZoneCodePanel">
              <label class="pv-multiselect-item pv-multiselect-all"><input type="checkbox" id="pvZoneCodeAll" onchange="pvToggleAllZoneCodes(this.checked)"> (Seleccionar todo)</label>
              <div id="pvZoneCodeOptions"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-export-actions">
          <button class="secondary-btn" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:0 12px" onclick="pvExportSelectAll(true)">Seleccionar todas</button>
          <button class="secondary-btn" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:0 12px" onclick="pvExportSelectAll(false)">Quitar todas</button>
          <span id="pvExportCount" style="margin-left:auto;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-export-list" id="pvExportList"></div>
      </div>

      <div id="pvExportCorpPanel" style="display:none">
        <div class="pv-field"><label>Departamentos de Corporativo</label></div>
        <div class="pv-export-actions">
          <button class="secondary-btn" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:0 12px" onclick="pvExportSelectAllDept('corp',true)">Seleccionar todos</button>
          <button class="secondary-btn" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:0 12px" onclick="pvExportSelectAllDept('corp',false)">Quitar todos</button>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-export-list" id="pvExportCorpList"></div>
      </div>

      <div id="pvExportCedisPanel" style="display:none">
        <div class="pv-field"><label>Departamentos de CEDIS</label></div>
        <div class="pv-export-actions">
          <button class="secondary-btn" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:0 12px" onclick="pvExportSelectAllDept('cedis',true)">Seleccionar todos</button>
          <button class="secondary-btn" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:0 12px" onclick="pvExportSelectAllDept('cedis',false)">Quitar todos</button>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-export-list" id="pvExportCedisList"></div>
      </div>

      <div id="pvExportDireccionesPanel" style="display:none">
        <div class="pv-field"><label>Direcciones (incluye Dirección General)</label></div>
        <div class="pv-export-actions">
          <button class="secondary-btn" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:0 12px" onclick="pvExportSelectAllDept('direcciones',true)">Seleccionar todas</button>
          <button class="secondary-btn" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:0 12px" onclick="pvExportSelectAllDept('direcciones',false)">Quitar todas</button>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-export-list" id="pvExportDireccionesList"></div>
      </div>

      <button class="upload-btn" onclick="pvGenerateExport()">Descargar PDF(s)</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="workspace sidebar-closed" id="workspace">
    <aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar"><div class="sidebar-inner">
      <p class="eyebrow">Explora la organización</p>
      <h2>Encuentra tu lugar en la estructura</h2>
      <p class="sidebar-intro">Busca a una persona o consulta la estructura completa de una sucursal o departamento.</p>

      <div class="field" id="personField">
        <label for="personInput">Nombre del colaborador</label>
        <div class="input-wrap">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg>
          <input id="personInput" placeholder="Nombre, puesto o # empleado" autocomplete="off" />
          <button class="clear-input" id="clearPerson" aria-label="Limpiar búsqueda">×</button>
        </div>
        <div class="results" id="personResults"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="field" id="departmentField">
        <label for="departmentInput">Sucursal / Departamento</label>
        <div class="input-wrap">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M3 21h18M5 21V7l7-4 7 4v14M9 9h.01M9 13h.01M9 17h.01M15 9h.01M15 13h.01M15 17h.01"/></svg>
          <input id="departmentInput" placeholder="Ej. Apodaca Centro o RH" autocomplete="off" />
          <button class="clear-input" id="clearDepartment" aria-label="Limpiar búsqueda">×</button>
        </div>
        <div class="results" id="departmentResults"></div>
      </div>

      <button class="secondary-btn" id="homeSidebar">Volver a la estructura directiva</button>
    </div></aside>

    <section class="canvas-shell" id="canvasShell">
      <div class="toolbar">
        <button class="icon-btn" id="toggleSidebar" aria-label="Mostrar u ocultar buscador"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16"/></svg></button>
        <button class="tool-btn back-btn" id="backView" disabled><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="m15 18-6-6 6-6"/></svg><span>Regresar</span></button>
        <span class="toolbar-divider"></span>
        <button class="tool-btn" id="expandAll">Expandir todo</button>
        <button class="tool-btn" id="collapseAll">Colapsar todo</button>
        <button class="tool-btn" id="collapseArea">Colapsar área</button>
        <button class="tool-btn" id="centerSelected">Centrar</button>
        <button class="tool-btn" id="centerDirection">Centrar dirección</button>
        <button class="tool-btn" id="expandAreaDirection">Expandir área y dirección</button>
        <label class="include-vacantes-label"><input type="checkbox" class="include-vacantes-toggle" onchange="toggleIncludeVacantes(this.checked)"> Incluir vacantes</label>
        <div class="view-toggle" aria-label="Cantidad máxima de posiciones por fila">
          <button id="view12" class="view-btn active" aria-pressed="true">Vista 12/fila</button>
          <button id="view6" class="view-btn" aria-pressed="false">Vista 6/fila</button>
        </div>
        <div class="toolbar-spacer"></div>
        <div class="toolbar-status">
          <button class="total-filter active" id="allStatuses" aria-pressed="true" title="Mostrar todos los estados"><span id="totalPositions">0</span> posiciones</button>
          <span class="status-breakdown" aria-label="Filtrar posiciones por estado">
            <button class="status-filter active active-status" data-status="active" aria-pressed="true"><span class="filter-dot"></span>Activos: <strong id="activePositions">0</strong></button>
            <button class="status-filter active suspended-status" data-status="suspended" aria-pressed="true"><span class="filter-dot"></span>Suspendido laboral: <strong id="suspendedPositions">0</strong></button>
            <button class="status-filter active vacant-status" data-status="vacant" aria-pressed="true"><span class="filter-dot"></span>Vacantes: <strong id="vacantPositions">0</strong></button>
          </span>
          <button class="total-filter" id="hcSummaryBtn" style="display:none" onclick="showHcSummary()" title="Ver plantilla vs autorizado por toda la operación">Plantilla vs Autorizado</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <svg id="orgSvg" aria-label="Organigrama interactivo"><g id="zoomLayer"><g id="linkLayer"></g><g id="nodeLayer"></g></g></svg>

      <div class="helper"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M8 11V7a2 2 0 0 1 4 0v4M12 11V5a2 2 0 0 1 4 0v6M16 11V8a2 2 0 0 1 4 0v6c0 4-3 7-7 7h-1c-3 0-5-2-6-4l-2-4a2 2 0 0 1 3-2l1 1"/></svg>Arrastra para mover · usa la rueda para acercar · haz clic para ver detalle</div>
      <div class="legend"><span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-dot active-dot"></span>Activa</span><span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-dot suspended-dot"></span>Suspendida</span><span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-dot vacant-dot"></span>Vacante</span></div>

      <aside class="detail" id="detailPanel"><div class="detail-accent"></div><div class="detail-body" id="detailBody"></div><button class="detail-close" id="detailClose" aria-label="Cerrar detalle">×</button></aside>
      <div class="empty-state" id="emptyState"><div class="empty-card"><h3>No encontramos estructura para mostrar</h3><p>Verifica la selección o la relación entre ID Posición e ID Posición Jefe Inmediato.</p></div></div>
      <div class="toast" id="toast"></div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <div class="print-view" id="printView" style="display:none">
    <div id="pvContent"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="plantilla-view" id="plantillaView" style="display:none">
    <div id="plantillaContent"></div>
  </div>
</div>

let publicMode=true;
let includeVacantes=false;
function applyVisibility(){
  records=allRecords.filter(r=>{
    const sk=statusKey(r);
    if(sk==="vacant")return includeVacantes;
    if(!publicMode)return true;
    return sk==="active"||sk==="placeholder";
  });
  document.body.classList.toggle("public-mode",publicMode);
  const hcBtn=document.getElementById("hcSummaryBtn");if(hcBtn)hcBtn.style.display=publicMode?"none":"";
  document.querySelectorAll(".include-vacantes-toggle").forEach(cb=>cb.checked=includeVacantes);
}
function toggleIncludeVacantes(checked){
  includeVacantes=checked;
  const view=captureViewportAnchor();
  applyVisibility();rebuildIndex();
  redrawPreservingViewport(view);
  if(document.getElementById("pvContent")&&document.getElementById("printView").style.display!=="none")renderPrintView();
}

function showHcSummary(){
  let totalAuthorized=0,totalActual=0,totalVacant=0,totalExcedente=0,rows=[];
  for(const posId in PLANTILLA_AUTORIZADA){
    const authorized=PLANTILLA_AUTORIZADA[posId];
    const rec=byId.get(posId);
    if(!rec)continue;
    const isZoneLevel=fold(rec.role||"").includes("gerente de zona")||fold(rec.role||"").includes("territorial");
    const selfActive=(!isZoneLevel&&statusKey(rec)==="active")?1:0;
    const actual=(activeDescendantCounts.get(posId)||0)+selfActive;
    const vacant=vacantDescendantCounts.get(posId)||0;
    totalAuthorized+=authorized;totalActual+=actual;totalVacant+=vacant;
    const diff=actual-authorized;if(diff>0)totalExcedente+=diff;
    rows.push({name:displayName(rec),role:rec.role,zone:displayZone(rec),authorized,actual,vacant,diff});
  }
  rows.sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(b.diff)-Math.abs(a.diff));
  const overallDiff=totalActual-totalAuthorized,overallCls=overallDiff===0?"hc-ok":"hc-bad";
  const rowsHtml=rows.map(r=>{
    const cls=r.diff===0?"hc-ok":"hc-bad";
    const diffTxt=r.diff===0?"":r.diff>0?` (+${r.diff})`:` (${r.diff})`;
    return `<tr><td>${safe(r.name)}</td><td>${safe(r.role)}${r.zone?` — ${safe(r.zone)}`:""}</td><td>${r.authorized}</td><td>${r.actual}</td><td>${r.vacant}</td><td class="${cls}">${r.actual}${diffTxt}</td></tr>`;
  }).join("");
  document.getElementById("detailBody").innerHTML=`<p class="detail-kicker">Vista RH</p><h3>Plantilla vs Autorizado</h3><p class="detail-name">Total de la operación (solo personal activo — no incluye suspendidos), con posiciones registradas en Posiciones Autorizadas.</p>
    <div class="detail-grid" style="margin-bottom:14px">
      <div class="detail-cell"><span>Plantilla autorizada (total)</span><b>${totalAuthorized}</b></div>
      <div class="detail-cell"><span>Plantilla activa (total)</span><b class="${overallCls}">${totalActual}${overallDiff!==0?` (${overallDiff>0?"+":""}${overallDiff})`:""}</b></div>
      <div class="detail-cell"><span>Total vacantes</span><b>${totalVacant}</b></div>
      <div class="detail-cell"><span>Total excedente</span><b class="${totalExcedente>0?"hc-bad":"hc-ok"}">${totalExcedente}</b></div>
    </div>
    <table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:10px">
      <thead><tr style="text-align:left;color:#70859a;font-size:8.5px;text-transform:uppercase"><th>Nombre</th><th>Puesto</th><th>Autorizado</th><th>Activo</th><th>Vacantes</th><th></th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${rowsHtml}</tbody>
    </table>`;
  document.getElementById("detailPanel").classList.add("open");
}

let statusFilter=new Set(ALL_STATUSES),filterBaseExpanded=null,filterShowsContext=false;

const svg=d3.select("#orgSvg"),zoomLayer=d3.select("#zoomLayer"),linkLayer=d3.select("#linkLayer"),nodeLayer=d3.select("#nodeLayer");
const zoom=d3.zoom().scaleExtent([.12,2.2]).on("zoom",event=>zoomLayer.attr("transform",event.transform));
svg.call(zoom).on("dblclick.zoom",null);

function text(v){return String(v==null?"":v).trim()}
function fold(v){return text(v).normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"").toLowerCase()}
function safe(v){return text(v).replace(/[&<>'"]/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;","'":"&#39;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]))}
function normalizeRecord(r){return{status:text(r.status),direction:text(r.direction),zone:text(r.zone),department:text(r.department),location:text(r.location),employeeNumber:text(r.employeeNumber),name:text(r.name),role:text(r.role),positionId:text(r.positionId),managerName:text(r.managerName),managerPositionId:text(r.managerPositionId),confidence:text(r.confidence),hireDate:text(r.hireDate),zoneManagerName:text(r.zoneManagerName),hrbpName:text(r.hrbpName),crhName:text(r.crhName),vacantSince:text(r.vacantSince),vacantType:text(r.vacantType)}}
function isVacant(r){return!r.name||fold(r.name).includes("vacante")||fold(r.status).includes("vacante")}
function isPlaceholder(r){return fold(r.status).includes("placeholder")||fold(r.role||"").includes("sin gerente de tienda")}
function isSuspended(r){return!isVacant(r)&&!isPlaceholder(r)&&fold(r.status)!=="activo"}
function statusKey(r){return isVacant(r)?"vacant":isPlaceholder(r)?"placeholder":isSuspended(r)?"suspended":"active"}
function displayZone(r){
  if(GZ_ZONA_MAP[r.positionId])return GZ_ZONA_MAP[r.positionId];
  if(r.zone&&fold(r.zone)!=="corporativo")return r.zone;
  return "";
}
function displayName(r){return isVacant(r)?"VACANTE":r.name||"Sin titular"}
function isStoreManager(r){const role=fold(r?.role);return role.includes("gerente de tienda")||role.includes("gerente en desarrollo")||role.includes("gerente entrenamiento")||(role==="gerente")}
function isOperations(r){return fold(r?.direction).includes("operaciones")}
function isZoneManager(r){return fold(r?.role).includes("gerente de zona")||!!(r&&GZ_ZONA_MAP[r.positionId])}
function storeKey(r){return fold(r?.location)||fold(r?.department)}
function storeCluster(manager,members,key,index){const sample=members[0];return{status:"",direction:manager.direction,zone:sample.zone,department:sample.department,location:sample.location,employeeNumber:"",name:sample.department||sample.location||`Sucursal ${index+1}`,role:"SUCURSAL",positionId:`__STORE__${manager.positionId}__${key.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,"-")||index}`,managerName:manager.name,managerPositionId:manager.positionId,confidence:"",_synthetic:true,_storeCluster:true}}
function sortOrgSiblings(a,b){
  if(isStoreManager(a)&&isStoreManager(b))return a.department.localeCompare(b.department,"es")||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,"es");
  return a.role.localeCompare(b.role,"es")||a.department.localeCompare(b.department,"es")||a.name.localeCompare(b.name,"es");
}
function base64ToBytes(b64){const bin=atob(b64),out=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)out[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);return out}
function bytesToBase64(bytes){let binary="";const chunk=32768;for(let i=0;i<bytes.length;i+=chunk)binary+=String.fromCharCode(...bytes.subarray(i,i+chunk));return btoa(binary)}

function rebuildIndex(){
  window.__managedZoneCache=new Map();
  byId=new Map();childrenById=new Map();visualManagerById=new Map();descendantCounts=new Map();activeDescendantCounts=new Map();vacantDescendantCounts=new Map();roots=[];
  records.forEach(r=>{if(r.positionId){byId.set(r.positionId,r);childrenById.set(r.positionId,[])}});
  records.forEach(r=>{
    if(!r.positionId)return;
    const managerId=r.managerPositionId&&byId.has(r.managerPositionId)?r.managerPositionId:"";
    visualManagerById.set(r.positionId,managerId);
    if(managerId)childrenById.get(managerId).push(r);else roots.push(r);
  });
  childrenById.forEach(kids=>kids.sort(sortOrgSiblings));
  const count=(id,seen=new Set())=>{
    if(seen.has(id))return{total:0,active:0,vacant:0};
    const next=new Set(seen);next.add(id);
    let total=0,active=0,vacant=0;
    (childrenById.get(id)||[]).forEach(c=>{
      const sub=count(c.positionId,next),sk=statusKey(c);
      total+=1+sub.total;
      active+=(sk==="active"?1:0)+sub.active;
      vacant+=(sk==="vacant"?1:0)+sub.vacant;
    });
    descendantCounts.set(id,total);activeDescendantCounts.set(id,active);vacantDescendantCounts.set(id,vacant);
    return{total,active,vacant};
  };
  roots.forEach(r=>count(r.positionId));
  if(!byId.has(focusId))focusId=byId.has(DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID)?DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID:roots[0]?.positionId||records[0]?.positionId||"";
  updateStats();
}

function ancestorPath(id){const path=[],seen=new Set();let current=byId.get(id);while(current&&!seen.has(current.positionId)){path.unshift(current);seen.add(current.positionId);current=byId.get(visualManagerById.get(current.positionId))}return path}
