  const tipoVacante=isVacant(r)&&r.vacantType?`<div class="detail-cell"><span>Tipo</span><b>${safe(r.vacantType)}</b></div>`:"";
  const isFamiliaDept=r.positionId===FAMILIA_DEPT_ROOT_ID,detailRole=isFamiliaDept?"FAMILIA":ROLE_TITLE_OVERRIDES[r.positionId]||(r.role||"Posición"),detailName=isFamiliaDept?"64-Familia":displayName(r),detailEmpNum=isFamiliaDept?"—":(r.employeeNumber||"—");
  document.getElementById("detailBody").innerHTML=`<p class="detail-kicker">${isVacant(r)?"Posición vacante":"Detalle de la posición"}</p><h3>${safe(detailRole)}</h3><p class="detail-name">${safe(detailName)}</p><div class="detail-grid"><div class="detail-cell"><span># Empleado</span><b>${safe(detailEmpNum)}</b></div><div class="detail-cell"><span>Estado</span><b>${safe(r.status||"—")}</b></div><div class="detail-cell wide"><span>Dirección</span><b>${safe(r.direction||"—")}</b></div><div class="detail-cell"><span>Zona</span><b>${safe(displayZone(r)||"—")}</b></div><div class="detail-cell"><span>Ubicación</span><b>${safe(r.location||"—")}</b></div><div class="detail-cell wide"><span>Departamento / Sucursal</span><b>${safe(r.department||"—")}</b></div><div class="detail-cell wide"><span>Reporta a</span><b>${safe(r.managerName||"Raíz organizacional")}</b></div>${tipoVacante}${fechaVacante}<div class="detail-cell"><span>Reportes directos</span><b>${direct}</b></div><div class="detail-cell"><span>Equipo total</span><b>${equipoTotalDisplay}</b></div>${plantillaCell}<div class="detail-cell wide"><span>ID Posición</span><b>${safe(r.positionId)}</b></div></div>`;
  document.getElementById("detailPanel").classList.add("open");
}
function closeDetail(){document.getElementById("detailPanel").classList.remove("open")}
function updateToolbarState(){
  const back=document.getElementById("backView"),view12=document.getElementById("view12"),view6=document.getElementById("view6");
  const currentId=spotlightId===AUDIT_ALIAS_ID?AUDIT_COUNCIL_ID:spotlightId,hasParent=!!(currentId&&(currentId===AUDIT_COUNCIL_ID&&auditAliasOpen?byId.has(DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID):visualManagerById.get(currentId)));back.disabled=!focusHistory.length&&!hasParent;view12.classList.toggle("active",maxPerRow===12);view6.classList.toggle("active",maxPerRow===6);view12.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(maxPerRow===12));view6.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(maxPerRow===6));
  document.querySelectorAll(".status-filter").forEach(button=>{const active=statusFilter.has(button.dataset.status);button.classList.toggle("active",active);button.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(active))});
  const all=document.getElementById("allStatuses"),allActive=statusFilter.size===ALL_STATUSES.length;all.classList.toggle("active",allActive);all.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(allActive));
}
function updateStats(){
  const active=records.filter(r=>fold(r.status)==="activo").length,vacant=records.filter(isVacant).length,suspended=records.length-active-vacant;
  const filteredTotal=records.filter(r=>statusFilter.has(statusKey(r))).length;
  document.getElementById("totalPositions").textContent=filteredTotal.toLocaleString("es-MX");document.getElementById("activePositions").textContent=active.toLocaleString("es-MX");document.getElementById("suspendedPositions").textContent=suspended.toLocaleString("es-MX");document.getElementById("vacantPositions").textContent=vacant.toLocaleString("es-MX");
}

function descendantsOf(id){const ids=[];const visit=current=>{for(const child of childrenById.get(current)||[]){ids.push(child.positionId);visit(child.positionId)}};visit(id);return ids}
function statusScopeRecords(){
  const scope=departmentMode?new Set(records.filter(r=>r.department===departmentMode).map(r=>r.positionId)):new Set([focusId,...descendantsOf(focusId)]);
  return records.filter(r=>scope.has(r.positionId)&&statusFilter.has(statusKey(r)));
}
function prepareStatusView(){
  const matches=statusScopeRecords();filterShowsContext=matches.length<=200;
  if(filterShowsContext)matches.forEach(record=>ancestorPath(record.positionId).forEach(ancestor=>expanded.add(ancestor.positionId)));
}
function toggleStatusFilter(key){
  if(statusFilter.has(key)&&statusFilter.size===1){toast("Selecciona al menos un estado");return}
  const view=captureViewportAnchor();
  pushHistory();
  if(statusFilter.size===ALL_STATUSES.length)filterBaseExpanded=new Set(expanded);
  if(statusFilter.has(key))statusFilter.delete(key);else statusFilter.add(key);
  if(statusFilter.size===ALL_STATUSES.length){if(filterBaseExpanded)expanded=new Set(filterBaseExpanded);filterBaseExpanded=null;filterShowsContext=false}else{expanded=new Set(filterBaseExpanded||expanded);prepareStatusView()}
  const selected=byId.get(selectedId);if(selected&&!statusFilter.has(statusKey(selected))){selectedId="";if(spotlightId===selected.positionId||selected.positionId===AUDIT_COUNCIL_ID){spotlightId="";auditAliasOpen=false}}const count=statusScopeRecords().length;closeDetail();redrawPreservingViewport(view);updateStats();toast(`Filtro aplicado: ${count.toLocaleString("es-MX")} posiciones`);
}
function showAllStatuses(){if(statusFilter.size===ALL_STATUSES.length)return;const view=captureViewportAnchor();pushHistory();statusFilter=new Set(ALL_STATUSES);if(filterBaseExpanded)expanded=new Set(filterBaseExpanded);filterBaseExpanded=null;filterShowsContext=false;redrawPreservingViewport(view);updateStats();toast(`Mostrando las ${records.length.toLocaleString("es-MX")} posiciones`)}
function currentRecord(){return byId.get(selectedId)||byId.get(focusId)}
function groupRoot(record,field){if(!record)return null;let root=record,parent=byId.get(visualManagerById.get(root.positionId));while(parent&&parent[field]&&parent[field]===record[field]){root=parent;parent=byId.get(visualManagerById.get(root.positionId))}return root}
function expandAll(){pushHistory();const members=departmentMode?records.filter(r=>r.department===departmentMode):records;spotlightId="";auditAliasOpen=!departmentMode;expanded=new Set(members.map(r=>r.positionId));draw({fit:true});toast("Estructura expandida")}
function collapseArea(){const record=currentRecord(),root=groupRoot(record,"department")||record;if(!root)return;pushHistory();auditAliasOpen=false;[root.positionId,...descendantsOf(root.positionId)].forEach(id=>expanded.delete(id));const parentId=visualManagerById.get(root.positionId),higherRoot=byId.get(parentId)||root;spotlightId=higherRoot.positionId;selectedId=higherRoot.positionId;draw({fit:true});toast("Área contraída")}
function collapseAllToDirectors(){pushHistory();auditAliasOpen=false;spotlightId="";focusId=byId.has(DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID)?DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID:focusId;selectedId=focusId;expanded=new Set([focusId]);closeDetail();draw({fit:true});toast("Vista contraída a Dirección General")}
function centerSelected(){pushHistory();const id=selectedId||focusId;if(id)centerNode(id);else fitVisible()}
function centerDirection(){const root=groupRoot(currentRecord(),"direction");pushHistory();if(!root){fitVisible();return}centerNode(root.positionId)}
function expandAreaAndDirection(){
  const record=currentRecord();if(!record)return;pushHistory();spotlightId="";auditAliasOpen=false;const directionRoot=groupRoot(record,"direction")||record,areaRoot=groupRoot(record,"department")||record,path=ancestorPath(record.positionId),start=Math.max(0,path.findIndex(r=>r.positionId===directionRoot.positionId));
  path.slice(start).forEach(r=>expanded.add(r.positionId));expanded.add(directionRoot.positionId);expanded.add(areaRoot.positionId);draw({fit:true});toast("Área y dirección expandidas");
}
function setMaxPerRow(value){if(maxPerRow===value)return;pushHistory();maxPerRow=value;draw({fit:true});toast(`Vista de hasta ${value} posiciones por fila`)}

function setupSearch(){
  bindCombo({inputId:"personInput",resultsId:"personResults",clearId:"clearPerson",search:q=>records.filter(r=>!isVacant(r)&&[r.name,r.role,r.employeeNumber].some(v=>fold(v).includes(q))).slice(0,9),render:r=>`<span class="result-main">${safe(r.name)}</span><span class="result-sub">${safe(r.role)} · #${safe(r.employeeNumber||"S/N")}</span>`,select:r=>focusOn(r.positionId)});
  const departments=()=>{const map=new Map();records.forEach(r=>{if(r.department){const item=map.get(r.department)||{name:r.department,zone:r.zone,count:0};item.count++;map.set(r.department,item)}});return[...map.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name,"es"))};
  bindCombo({inputId:"departmentInput",resultsId:"departmentResults",clearId:"clearDepartment",search:q=>departments().filter(d=>fold(d.name+" "+d.zone).includes(q)).slice(0,10),render:d=>`<span class="result-main">${safe(d.name)}</span><span class="result-sub">${safe(d.zone||"Sin zona")} · ${d.count} posiciones</span>`,select:d=>showDepartment(d.name)});
}
function bindCombo({inputId,resultsId,clearId,search,render,select}){
  const input=document.getElementById(inputId),results=document.getElementById(resultsId),clear=document.getElementById(clearId),close=()=>results.classList.remove("open");
  const refresh=()=>{const q=fold(input.value);clear.classList.toggle("visible",!!q);if(q.length<2){close();return}const items=search(q);results.innerHTML=items.length?items.map((item,i)=>`<button class="result-item" data-index="${i}">${render(item)}</button>`).join(""):`<div class="no-results">No encontramos coincidencias.</div>`;results.classList.add("open");results.querySelectorAll("[data-index]").forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener("click",()=>{const item=items[Number(btn.dataset.index)];input.value=item.name;clear.classList.add("visible");close();select(item)}))};
  input.addEventListener("input",refresh);input.addEventListener("focus",refresh);clear.addEventListener("click",()=>{input.value="";clear.classList.remove("visible");close();input.focus()});document.addEventListener("click",e=>{if(!e.target.closest(`#${inputId}`)&&!e.target.closest(`#${resultsId}`))close()});
}

function parseWorkbookBytes(bytes){
  const wb=XLSX.read(bytes,{type:"array"}),sheetName=wb.SheetNames.includes("1_Base_Consolidada")?"1_Base_Consolidada":wb.SheetNames[0],rows=XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets[sheetName],{defval:"",raw:false}),headers=rows.length?Object.keys(rows[0]):[],missing=REQUIRED_HEADERS.filter(h=>!headers.includes(h));
  if(missing.length)throw new Error("Faltan columnas requeridas: "+missing.join(", ")+".");
  return rows.map(r=>normalizeRecord({status:r.Estado,direction:r["Dirección"],zone:r.Zona,department:r.Departamento,location:r["Ubicación"],employeeNumber:r["#Empleado"],name:r.Nombre,role:r["Nombre de Puesto"],positionId:r["ID Posicion"],managerName:r["Nombre de Jefe Inmediato"],managerPositionId:r["ID de Jefe Inmediato"],confidence:r.Confianza,hireDate:r["Fecha de Ingreso"],zoneManagerName:r["Nombre de Gerente de Zona"],hrbpName:r["Nombre de HRBP"],crhName:r["Nombre de Coordinadora de RH"],vacantSince:r["Fecha Apertura Vacante"],vacantType:r["Tipo de Vacante"]})).filter(r=>r.positionId);
}
function loadEmbeddedWorkbook(){
  if(!ORIGINAL_XLSX_B64||!window.XLSX)return false;
  try{
    const next=parseWorkbookBytes(currentWorkbookBytes);
    validateRecords(next);allRecords=next;applyVisibility();focusId=next.some(r=>r.positionId===DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID)?DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID:next[0].positionId;selectedId=focusId;expanded=new Set([focusId]);rebuildIndex();
    const sourceLabel=document.getElementById("sourceLabel");if(sourceLabel)sourceLabel.textContent="Excel incrustado · buscando actualización en línea…";
    return true;
  }catch(error){console.error("No fue posible leer el Excel incrustado:",error);return false}
}

async function loadRemoteExcel(){
  const sourceUrl=new URL(REMOTE_XLSX_URL,location.href).href,sourceLabel=document.getElementById("sourceLabel");
  try{
    if(sourceLabel)sourceLabel.textContent="Cargando Excel oficial…";
    if(!window.XLSX)throw new Error("No fue posible activar el lector de Excel.");
    const separator=sourceUrl.includes("?")?"&":"?",response=await fetch(sourceUrl+separator+"actualizacion="+Date.now(),{cache:"no-store"});
    if(!response.ok)throw new Error("La fuente respondió con el código "+response.status+".");
    const bytes=new Uint8Array(await response.arrayBuffer()),next=parseWorkbookBytes(bytes);
    validateRecords(next);allRecords=next;applyVisibility();currentWorkbookBytes=bytes;focusId=next.some(r=>r.positionId===DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID)?DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID:next[0].positionId;selectedId=focusId;departmentMode="";spotlightId="";auditAliasOpen=false;expanded=new Set([focusId]);focusHistory=[];statusFilter=new Set(ALL_STATUSES);filterBaseExpanded=null;filterShowsContext=false;rebuildIndex();if(sourceLabel)sourceLabel.textContent="Excel oficial · actualización automática";draw({fit:true});toast("Información actualizada desde Excel");if(typeof renderPrintView==="function")renderPrintView();
  }catch(error){
    console.error("No fue posible leer la fuente automática:",error);
    if(records.length){
      if(sourceLabel)sourceLabel.textContent="Excel incrustado (sin conexión al Excel en línea)";
    }else{
      records=[];rebuildIndex();draw({fit:true});if(sourceLabel)sourceLabel.textContent="No fue posible leer el Excel";
    }
  }
}

function validateRecords(next){const ids=new Set();for(const r of next){if(ids.has(r.positionId))throw new Error(`El ID Posición ${r.positionId} está duplicado.`);ids.add(r.positionId)}const orphan=next.find(r=>r.managerPositionId&&!ids.has(r.managerPositionId));if(orphan)throw new Error(`La posición ${orphan.positionId} reporta a un ID que no existe: ${orphan.managerPositionId}.`)}
function toast(message){const el=document.getElementById("toast");el.textContent=message;el.classList.add("show");clearTimeout(toast.timer);toast.timer=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove("show"),2200)}
function closeSidebar(){document.getElementById("workspace").classList.add("sidebar-closed")}
function home(){focusOn(byId.has(DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID)?DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID:roots[0]?.positionId||focusId);closeDetail()}

document.getElementById("toggleSidebar").addEventListener("click",()=>document.getElementById("workspace").classList.toggle("sidebar-closed"));
document.getElementById("backView").addEventListener("click",goBack);document.getElementById("expandAll").addEventListener("click",expandAll);document.getElementById("collapseAll").addEventListener("click",collapseAllToDirectors);document.getElementById("collapseArea").addEventListener("click",collapseArea);document.getElementById("centerSelected").addEventListener("click",centerSelected);document.getElementById("centerDirection").addEventListener("click",centerDirection);document.getElementById("expandAreaDirection").addEventListener("click",expandAreaAndDirection);document.getElementById("view12").addEventListener("click",()=>setMaxPerRow(12));document.getElementById("view6").addEventListener("click",()=>setMaxPerRow(6));
document.querySelectorAll(".status-filter").forEach(button=>button.addEventListener("click",()=>toggleStatusFilter(button.dataset.status)));document.getElementById("allStatuses").addEventListener("click",showAllStatuses);
document.getElementById("homeSidebar").addEventListener("click",home);document.getElementById("detailClose").addEventListener("click",closeDetail);
document.getElementById("rhPassInput").addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="Enter")rhSubmitLogin()});
document.getElementById("rhLoginOverlay").addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target.id==="rhLoginOverlay")rhCloseLogin()});
document.getElementById("pvExportOverlay").addEventListener("click",e=>{if(e.target.id==="pvExportOverlay")pvCloseExportModal()});
document.addEventListener("click",e=>{
  const multi=document.getElementById("pvZoneCodeMulti");
  if(multi&&!multi.contains(e.target))document.getElementById("pvZoneCodePanel").classList.remove("open");
});


window.addEventListener("resize",()=>requestAnimationFrame(fitVisible));
[120,400,900].forEach(delay=>setTimeout(()=>{if(document.getElementById("workspace").style.display!=="none")fitVisible()},delay));


</script>
<script>
/* ===================== VISTA IMPRESIÓN (Dirección de Ventas por sucursal) ===================== */
let pvZoneId="",pvStoreId="",pvRendered=false,pvHcVisible=false;

/* ===================== ACCESO RH (control de vista, no es seguridad real) ===================== */
// IMPORTANTE: esto es un candado de conveniencia en el navegador, NO seguridad real — cualquiera
// que revise el código fuente de este HTML puede ver los usuarios y contraseñas. Sirve para que
// el personal no-RH no navegue por accidente a la vista completa, no para proteger datos sensibles.
const RH_USERS=[
  {user:"Gerente.Do",pass:"Organigrama2026",label:"Gerente D.O. (administrador)",admin:true},
  {user:"HRBP.CORP",pass:"Organigrama2026Corp",label:"HRBP Corporativo",admin:false},
  {user:"HRBP.CEDIS",pass:"Organigrama2026Cedis",label:"HRBP CEDIS",admin:false},
  {user:"HRBP.ZONAINT",pass:"Organigrama2026Zona",label:"HRBP Zona Interior",admin:false},
  {user:"HRBP.ZONAFR",pass:"Organigrama2026Zona",label:"HRBP Zona Frontera",admin:false},
  {user:"HRBP",pass:"Organigrama2026",label:"HRBP",admin:false},
];
let rhLoggedIn=false,rhIsAdmin=false,rhLabel="";

function rhOpenLogin(){
  document.getElementById("rhLoginOverlay").classList.add("open");
  document.getElementById("rhLoginError").classList.remove("show");
  document.getElementById("rhUserInput").value="";document.getElementById("rhPassInput").value="";
  document.getElementById("rhUserInput").focus();
}
function rhCloseLogin(){document.getElementById("rhLoginOverlay").classList.remove("open")}
function rhSubmitLogin(){
  const u=document.getElementById("rhUserInput").value.trim(),p=document.getElementById("rhPassInput").value;
  const match=RH_USERS.find(r=>r.user.toLowerCase()===u.toLowerCase()&&r.pass===p);
  const err=document.getElementById("rhLoginError");
  if(!match){err.textContent="Usuario o contraseña incorrectos.";err.classList.add("show");return}
  rhLoggedIn=true;rhIsAdmin=match.admin;rhLabel=match.label;
  try{sessionStorage.setItem("rhSession",JSON.stringify({user:match.user,admin:match.admin,label:match.label}))}catch(e){}
  rhApplyLoginUI();rhCloseLogin();toast(`Bienvenido, ${match.label}`);
}
function rhLogout(){
  rhLoggedIn=false;rhIsAdmin=false;rhLabel="";
  try{sessionStorage.removeItem("rhSession")}catch(e){}
  rhApplyLoginUI();
  if(!publicMode)showTab("org");
}
function rhApplyLoginUI(){
  document.getElementById("tabBtnRhOrg").style.display=rhLoggedIn?"":"none";
  document.getElementById("tabBtnPlantilla").style.display=rhLoggedIn?"":"none";
  document.getElementById("rhLoginBtn").style.display=rhLoggedIn?"none":"";
  document.getElementById("rhUserBadge").style.display=rhLoggedIn?"inline-flex":"none";
  document.getElementById("rhUserName").textContent=rhLabel;
}
function rhRestoreSession(){
  try{
    const raw=sessionStorage.getItem("rhSession");if(!raw)return;
    const saved=JSON.parse(raw);
    if(RH_USERS.some(r=>r.user===saved.user)){rhLoggedIn=true;rhIsAdmin=!!saved.admin;rhLabel=saved.label;rhApplyLoginUI()}
  }catch(e){}
}

/* ===================== PLANTILLA OPERATIVA ===================== */
// Los enlaces de descarga "oficiales" (visibles para todos) se sirven mejor desde una URL de tu
// WordPress, igual que el Excel — así sí funcionan para cualquier persona, en cualquier equipo.
// Configúralas aquí una vez que subas los archivos a tu servidor:
window.__PLANTILLA_OPERATIVA_URL__=window.__PLANTILLA_OPERATIVA_URL__||"";
window.__AJUSTE_PLANTILLA_URL__=window.__AJUSTE_PLANTILLA_URL__||"";

function plantillaLocalFile(key){
  try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(key);return raw?JSON.parse(raw):null}catch(e){return null}
}
function plantillaSaveLocalFile(key,file){
  const reader=new FileReader();
  reader.onload=()=>{
    try{localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify({name:file.name,dataUrl:reader.result,savedAt:new Date().toISOString()}));toast("Archivo guardado en este navegador");renderPlantillaView()}
    catch(e){toast("El archivo es muy grande para guardarlo localmente")}
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

const ACTIVOS_JOMAR_DATA=window.__ACTIVOS_JOMAR__||[];
const ACTIVOS_JOMAR_BUILD=window.__ACTIVOS_JOMAR_BUILD__||"";
let jomarSearch={activos:"",suspendidos:""};
let jomarSort={activos:{col:"",dir:1},suspendidos:{col:"",dir:1}};
const JOMAR_COLS=[["numEmpleado","# Empleado"],["nombre","Nombre"],["puesto","Puesto"],["direccion","Dirección"],["zonaArea","Zona"],["sucursal","Sucursal / Depto"],["jefeInmediato","Jefe Inmediato en Organigrama"]];
function jomarRowsFor(estadoTarget){
  return ACTIVOS_JOMAR_DATA.filter(r=>fold(r.estado)===fold(estadoTarget));
}
function jomarFilterRows(rows,term){
  const t=fold(term).trim();
  if(!t)return rows;
  return rows.filter(r=>[r.nombre,r.puesto,r.sucursal,r.zonaArea,r.direccion,r.numEmpleado,r.jefeInmediato].some(v=>fold(v).includes(t)));
}
function jomarSortRows(rows,key){
  const{col,dir}=jomarSort[key];
  if(!col)return rows;
  const sorted=[...rows].sort((a,b)=>{
    const av=a[col],bv=b[col];
    const an=parseFloat(av),bn=parseFloat(bv);
    if(!isNaN(an)&&!isNaN(bn)&&fold(av)===String(an)&&fold(bv)===String(bn))return(an-bn)*dir;
    return fold(av).localeCompare(fold(bv),"es")*dir;
  });
  return sorted;
}
function jomarToggleSort(key,col){
  const s=jomarSort[key];
  if(s.col===col)s.dir=-s.dir;else{s.col=col;s.dir=1}
  renderPlantillaView();
}
function jomarTableHtml(rows,key){
  if(!rows.length)return `<div class="no-file">Sin resultados para este filtro.</div>`;
  const body=rows.map(r=>`<tr><td>${safe(r.numEmpleado)}</td><td>${safe(r.nombre)}</td><td>${safe(r.puesto)}</td><td>${safe(r.direccion)}</td><td>${safe(r.zonaArea)}</td><td>${safe(r.sucursal)}</td><td>${safe(r.jefeInmediato)}</td></tr>`).join("");
  const{col,dir}=jomarSort[key];
  const head=JOMAR_COLS.map(([field,label])=>`<th class="jomar-sortable" onclick="jomarToggleSort('${key}','${field}')">${safe(label)}${col===field?(dir===1?" ▲":" ▼"):""}</th>`).join("");
  return `<div class="jomar-table-wrap"><table class="jomar-table"><thead><tr>${head}</tr></thead><tbody>${body}</tbody></table></div><div class="jomar-count">${rows.length} colaborador${rows.length===1?"":"es"}</div>`;
}
function renderJomarSection(key,estadoTarget,title){
  const all=jomarRowsFor(estadoTarget);
  const filtered=jomarSortRows(jomarFilterRows(all,jomarSearch[key]),key);
  return `
    <div class="plantilla-card wide">
      <div class="jomar-head">
        <div>
          <h3 style="margin-bottom:2px">${safe(title)}</h3>
          <div class="jomar-meta">Fecha de actualización: ${safe(ACTIVOS_JOMAR_BUILD)} · ${all.length} registro${all.length===1?"":"s"} en total</div>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap">
          <input class="jomar-filter" type="text" placeholder="Filtrar por nombre, puesto, sucursal, zona..." value="${safe(jomarSearch[key])}" oninput="jomarSearch['${key}']=this.value;renderPlantillaView()">
          <a class="dl-link orange" href="javascript:void(0)" onclick="exportJomarExcel('${key}')">⬇ Descargar Excel</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      ${jomarTableHtml(filtered,key)}
    </div>`;
}
function exportJomarExcel(key){
  if(!window.XLSX)return;
  const estadoTarget=key==="activos"?"Activo":"Suspendido Laboral";
  const rows=jomarSortRows(jomarFilterRows(jomarRowsFor(estadoTarget),jomarSearch[key]),key);
  const data=rows.map(r=>({
    "# Empleado":r.numEmpleado,"Nombre":r.nombre,"Puesto":r.puesto,"Estado":r.estado,
    "Dirección":r.direccion,"Zona":r.zonaArea,"Sucursal / Depto":r.sucursal,
    "Fecha Antigüedad":r.antiguedad,"Jefe Inmediato en Organigrama":r.jefeInmediato
  }));
  const ws=XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(data);
  const wb=XLSX.utils.book_new();
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb,ws,key==="activos"?"Activos JOMAR":"Suspendidos JOMAR");
  XLSX.writeFile(wb,(key==="activos"?"Activos_JOMAR_":"Suspendidos_Laboral_JOMAR_")+ACTIVOS_JOMAR_BUILD.replace(/[\/: ]/g,"-")+".xlsx");
}
function renderPlantillaView(){
  const content=document.getElementById("plantillaContent");
  content.innerHTML=`
    ${renderJomarSection("activos","Activo","Activos JOMAR")}
    ${renderJomarSection("suspendidos","Suspendido Laboral","Suspendidos Laboral JOMAR")}
  `;
}

function showTab(name){
  if((name==="rhorg"||name==="plantilla")&&!rhLoggedIn){rhOpenLogin();return}
  document.getElementById("tabBtnOrg").classList.toggle("active",name==="org");
  document.getElementById("tabBtnPrint").classList.toggle("active",name==="print");
  document.getElementById("tabBtnRhOrg").classList.toggle("active",name==="rhorg");
  document.getElementById("tabBtnPlantilla").classList.toggle("active",name==="plantilla");
  document.getElementById("workspace").style.display=(name==="org"||name==="rhorg")?"grid":"none";
  document.getElementById("printView").style.display=name==="print"?"block":"none";
  document.getElementById("plantillaView").style.display=name==="plantilla"?"block":"none";

  const wantPublic=name!=="rhorg";
  if(wantPublic!==publicMode){
    publicMode=wantPublic;applyVisibility();
    focusId=byId.has(DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID)&&records.some(r=>r.positionId===DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID)?DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID:(records[0]?.positionId||"");
    selectedId=focusId;spotlightId="";auditAliasOpen=false;departmentMode="";expanded=new Set([focusId]);focusHistory=[];
    statusFilter=new Set(ALL_STATUSES);filterBaseExpanded=null;filterShowsContext=false;
    rebuildIndex();draw({fit:true});
  }
  if(name==="print")renderPrintView();
  if(name==="plantilla")renderPlantillaView();
}

const PV_LOGO_SRC="data:image/png;base64,";
function pvVentasDirector(){
  return records.find(r=>fold(r.role).includes("director")&&fold(r.role).includes("venta"));
}
function pvIsZoneManager(r){return isZoneManager(r)}
function pvIsStoreManager(r){return isStoreManager(r)}
function pvIsManagerial(r){const role=fold(r.role);return["gerente","supervisor","director","coordinador","jefe"].some(k=>role.includes(k))}

function pvStoreTotal(storeRecord){
  const loc=storeRecord.location;
  return records.filter(r=>r.location===loc).length;
}
function pvToggleHc(){
  pvHcVisible=!pvHcVisible;
  document.getElementById("pvHcBtn").classList.toggle("active",pvHcVisible);
  if(pvZoneId)pvRenderZone(pvZoneId);
  if(pvStoreId)pvRenderStore(pvStoreId);
}
function pvPrintStore(){window.print()}

function pvCardHtml(r){
  const vac=isVacant(r);
  return `<div class="pv-card${vac?" vacant":""}"><div class="role">${safe(ROLE_TITLE_OVERRIDES[r.positionId]||r.role||"Posición")}</div><div class="name">${safe(displayName(r))}</div></div>`;
}

function pvStoreRoster(storeRecord){
  // Se agrupa por UBICACIÓN FÍSICA (no por línea de reporte formal): así se ve la plantilla
  // real de cada sucursal aunque el "Reporta a" del personal de piso apunte al Gerente de Zona.
  const loc=storeRecord.location;
  const team=records.filter(r=>r.location===loc&&r.positionId!==storeRecord.positionId);
  const groups=new Map();
  team.forEach(r=>{const key=r.role||"Sin puesto";if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,[]);groups.get(key).push(r)});
  return{team,roleGroups:[...groups.entries()].map(([role,list])=>({role,list}))};
}

function pvRenderRoleBox(role,list){
  const items=list.map(r=>{
    const zoneNote=r.serviceZones&&r.serviceZones.length?`<span class="pv-zone-note"> — ${safe(pvFormatZones(r.serviceZones))}</span>`:"";
    return `<li class="${isVacant(r)?"vacant-name":""}">${safe(displayName(r))}${zoneNote}</li>`;
  }).join("");
  return `<div class="pv-role-box">
    <div class="head" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('collapsed')"><span>${safe(role)} (${list.length})</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
    <ul>${items}</ul>
  </div>`;
}
function pvFormatZones(zones){
  const nums=zones.map(z=>{const m=/Z(\d+)\s*-\s*Interior/i.exec(z);return m?m[1]:null});
  if(zones.length&&nums.every(Boolean)){
    return`Zona Interior ${nums.join(", ")}`;
  }
  return zones.join(", ");
}

function pvRenderStore(storeId){
  pvStoreId=storeId;
  const sm=byId.get(storeId);
  const box=document.getElementById("pvStoreBox");
  if(!sm){box.innerHTML=`<div class="pv-empty">Selecciona una sucursal para ver su plantilla.</div>`;return}
  const{team,roleGroups}=pvStoreRoster(sm);
  const zoneManager=byId.get(visualManagerById.get(sm.positionId));
  const zoneLabel=sm.zone&&fold(sm.zone)!=="corporativo"?sm.zone:"";
  box.innerHTML=`
    <div class="pv-store">
      <div class="pv-store-page">
        <div class="pv-store-head">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px">
            <img class="pv-store-logo" src="${PV_LOGO_SRC}" alt="JOMAR Autopartes">
            <div>
              <div class="pv-store-title">${safe(sm.department||sm.location)}</div>
              <div class="pv-store-sub">Ubicación: ${safe(sm.location)} &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${team.length+1} personas totales</div>
              ${zoneLabel||zoneManager?`<div class="pv-store-sub" style="margin-top:2px;font-weight:700;color:var(--b800)">${zoneLabel?`Zona: ${safe(zoneLabel)}`:""}${zoneLabel&&zoneManager?" &nbsp;·&nbsp; ":""}${zoneManager?`Gerente de Zona: ${safe(displayName(zoneManager))}`:""}</div>`:""}
            </div>
          </div>
          <button class="pv-print-btn" onclick="pvPrintStore()">🖨️ Imprimir / Guardar PDF</button>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-tree">
          <div class="pv-manager-row">
            <div class="pv-manager-card"><div class="role">${safe(sm.role)}</div><div class="name">${safe(displayName(sm))}</div>${pvHcVisible?`<div class="hc-line">${team.length+1}</div>`:""}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="pv-role-groups">
            ${roleGroups.length?roleGroups.map(g=>pvRenderRoleBox(g.role,g.list)).join(""):'<div class="pv-empty">Sin personal adicional registrado en esta sucursal.</div>'}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
}

function pvRenderZone(zoneId){
  pvZoneId=zoneId;
  const zoneBlock=document.getElementById("pvZoneBlock"),storeSelect=document.getElementById("pvStoreSelect");
  const zoneRecord=byId.get(zoneId);
  if(!zoneRecord){zoneBlock.innerHTML="";storeSelect.innerHTML="";document.getElementById("pvStoreBox").innerHTML="";return}
  const allDirects=childrenById.get(zoneId)||[],directs=allDirects.filter(pvIsManagerial);
  const zoneTotal=descendantsOf(zoneId).length;
  zoneBlock.innerHTML=`
    <h3>${safe(displayName(zoneRecord))}</h3>
    <div class="zone-sub">${safe(zoneRecord.role)} · ${directs.length} reporte${directs.length===1?"":"s"} directo${directs.length===1?"":"s"}</div>
    ${directs.length?`
      <div class="pv-zone-tree">
        <div class="pv-zone-manager-row">
          <div class="pv-manager-card"><div class="role">${safe(zoneRecord.role)}</div><div class="name">${safe(displayName(zoneRecord))}</div>${pvHcVisible?`<div class="hc-line">HC total: ${zoneTotal}</div>`:""}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-zone-nodes">
          ${directs.map(d=>{
            const hc=pvIsStoreManager(d)?pvStoreTotal(d):null;
            return `<div class="pv-node-box${isVacant(d)?" vacant":""}"><div class="role">${safe(d.role)}</div><div class="name">${safe(displayName(d))}</div>${pvHcVisible&&hc!=null?`<div class="hc-line">${hc}</div>`:""}</div>`;
          }).join("")}
        </div>
      </div>`:'<div class="pv-empty">Sin reportes directos registrados.</div>'}
  `;
  const stores=descendantsOf(zoneId).map(id=>byId.get(id)).filter(Boolean).filter(pvIsStoreManager);
  storeSelect.innerHTML="";
  document.getElementById("pvStoreBox").innerHTML=`<div class="pv-empty">Selecciona una sucursal arriba para ver su organigrama completo.</div>`;
  if(!stores.length){
    storeSelect.innerHTML=`<option value="">Sin sucursales registradas</option>`;
    return;
  }
  const placeholder=document.createElement("option");
  placeholder.value="";placeholder.textContent="Selecciona una sucursal…";
  storeSelect.appendChild(placeholder);
  stores.forEach(s=>{
    const opt=document.createElement("option");
    opt.value=s.positionId;
    opt.textContent=`${s.department||s.location} (${s.location}) — ${safe(displayName(s))}`;
    storeSelect.appendChild(opt);
  });
}

function pvExpandAll(collapse){
  document.querySelectorAll("#pvStoreBox .pv-role-box").forEach(box=>box.classList.toggle("collapsed",collapse));
}

function pvRenderAllStores(){
  if(!pvZoneId)return;
  const stores=descendantsOf(pvZoneId).map(id=>byId.get(id)).filter(Boolean).filter(pvIsStoreManager);
  const box=document.getElementById("pvStoreBox");
  document.getElementById("pvStoreSelect").value="";
  if(!stores.length){box.innerHTML=`<div class="pv-empty">Esta zona no tiene sucursales registradas.</div>`;return}
  box.innerHTML=`<div style="text-align:right;padding:0 0 14px"><button class="pv-print-btn" onclick="pvPrintStore()">🖨️ Imprimir / Guardar PDF (todas)</button></div>`+stores.map((sm,idx)=>{
    const{team,roleGroups}=pvStoreRoster(sm);
    const breakClass=idx>0?"pv-page-break-before":"";
    return `
    <div class="pv-store ${breakClass}">
      <div class="pv-store-page">
        <div class="pv-store-head">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px">
            <img class="pv-store-logo" src="${PV_LOGO_SRC}" alt="JOMAR Autopartes">
            <div>
              <div class="pv-store-title">${safe(sm.department||sm.location)}</div>
              <div class="pv-store-sub">Ubicación: ${safe(sm.location)} &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${team.length+1} personas totales</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-tree">
          <div class="pv-manager-row">
            <div class="pv-manager-card"><div class="role">${safe(sm.role)}</div><div class="name">${safe(displayName(sm))}</div>${pvHcVisible?`<div class="hc-line">${team.length+1}</div>`:""}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="pv-role-groups">
            ${roleGroups.length?roleGroups.map(g=>pvRenderRoleBox(g.role,g.list)).join(""):'<div class="pv-empty">Sin personal adicional registrado en esta sucursal.</div>'}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("")+`<div style="text-align:center;padding:14px"><button class="pv-print-btn" onclick="pvPrintStore()">🖨️ Imprimir / Guardar PDF (todas)</button></div>`;
}

function pvAllStoresWithZone(){
  const director=pvVentasDirector();
  if(!director)return[];
  const zoneManagers=descendantsOf(director.positionId).map(id=>byId.get(id)).filter(Boolean).filter(pvIsZoneManager);
  const out=[];
  zoneManagers.forEach(zm=>{
    const stores=descendantsOf(zm.positionId).map(id=>byId.get(id)).filter(Boolean).filter(pvIsStoreManager);
    stores.forEach(sm=>out.push({store:sm,zoneManager:zm}));
  });
  return out.sort((a,b)=>(a.zoneManager.name||"").localeCompare(b.zoneManager.name||"")||(a.store.department||"").localeCompare(b.store.department||""));
}

function pvCorpCedisGroups(){
  const ventasId=(pvVentasDirector()||{}).positionId;
  const buildFromZone=zoneMatch=>{
    const depts=new Map();
    records.forEach(r=>{
      if(fold(r.zone||"")!==zoneMatch)return;
      if(r.positionId===ventasId)return;
      const key=r.department||"(Sin departamento)";
      if(!depts.has(key))depts.set(key,[]);
      depts.get(key).push(r);
    });
    const out=[];
    depts.forEach((members,dept)=>{
      const memberIds=new Set(members.map(m=>m.positionId));
      const root=members.find(m=>!memberIds.has(m.managerPositionId))||members[0];
      out.push({...root,department:dept,_deptMembers:members});
    });
    return out.sort((a,b)=>(a.department||"").localeCompare(b.department||"","es"));
  };
  return{corp:buildFromZone("corporativo"),cedis:buildFromZone("cedis")};
}
function pvOpenExportModal(){
  const list=pvAllStoresWithZone();
  const container=document.getElementById("pvExportList");
  let lastZone="";
  container.innerHTML=list.map(({store,zoneManager})=>{
    const zoneName=displayName(zoneManager);
    const zoneCode=store.zone||"";
    const header=zoneName!==lastZone?(lastZone=zoneName,`<div class="pv-export-zone-label" data-zone="${safe(zoneName)}">${safe(zoneName)}</div>`):"";
    return `${header}<label class="pv-export-item" data-zone="${safe(zoneName)}" data-zonacode="${safe(zoneCode)}"><input type="checkbox" value="${store.positionId}" onchange="pvUpdateExportCount()"><span class="nm">${safe(store.department||store.location)}</span><span class="sub">${safe(store.location)}</span></label>`;
  }).join("")||'<div class="pv-empty">No se encontraron sucursales.</div>';

  const zoneNames=[...new Set(list.map(({zoneManager})=>displayName(zoneManager)))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,"es"));
  const rangeSelect=document.getElementById("pvZoneRangeSelect");
  rangeSelect.innerHTML=`<option value="">Todos los gerentes</option>`+zoneNames.map(z=>`<option value="${safe(z)}">${safe(z)}</option>`).join("");

  const zoneCodes=[...new Set(list.map(({store})=>store.zone).filter(Boolean))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,"es"));
  document.getElementById("pvZoneCodeOptions").innerHTML=zoneCodes.map(z=>`<label class="pv-multiselect-item"><input type="checkbox" value="${safe(z)}" onchange="pvUpdateZoneCodeSelection()"> ${safe(z)}</label>`).join("");
  document.getElementById("pvZoneCodeAll").checked=false;
  document.getElementById("pvZoneCodeBtn").textContent="Todas las zonas";

  const{corp,cedis}=pvCorpCedisGroups();
  const buildDeptList=(items,containerId)=>{
    document.getElementById(containerId).innerHTML=items.map(d=>{
      const count=d._deptMembers?d._deptMembers.length:1+(descendantCounts.get(d.positionId)||0);
      return `<label class="pv-export-item"><input type="checkbox" value="${d.positionId}"><span class="nm">${safe(d.department)}</span><span class="sub">${safe(displayName(d))} · ${count} personas</span></label>`;
    }).join("")||'<div class="pv-empty">No se encontraron departamentos.</div>';
  };
  buildDeptList(corp,"pvExportCorpList");
  buildDeptList(cedis,"pvExportCedisList");

  const direccionesList=pvDireccionesForExport();
  document.getElementById("pvExportDireccionesList").innerHTML=direccionesList.map(d=>{
    const count=d.people.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+1+(descendantCounts.get(p.positionId)||0),0);
    return `<label class="pv-export-item"><input type="checkbox" value="${safe(d.key)}"><span class="nm">${safe(d.role)}</span><span class="sub">${d.people.map(p=>safe(displayName(p))).join(" · ")} · ${count} personas</span></label>`;
  }).join("")||'<div class="pv-empty">No se encontraron direcciones.</div>';

  document.getElementById("pvExportSearch").value="";
  document.getElementById("pvCatSucursal").checked=true;
  document.getElementById("pvCatCorporativo").checked=false;
  document.getElementById("pvCatCedis").checked=false;
  document.getElementById("pvCatDirecciones").checked=false;
  pvToggleExportCategory();
  pvUpdateExportCount();
  document.getElementById("pvExportOverlay").classList.add("open");
}
function pvCloseExportModal(){document.getElementById("pvExportOverlay").classList.remove("open")}
function pvToggleExportCategory(){
  document.getElementById("pvExportSucursalPanel").style.display=document.getElementById("pvCatSucursal").checked?"":"none";
  document.getElementById("pvExportCorpPanel").style.display=document.getElementById("pvCatCorporativo").checked?"":"none";
  document.getElementById("pvExportCedisPanel").style.display=document.getElementById("pvCatCedis").checked?"":"none";
  document.getElementById("pvExportDireccionesPanel").style.display=document.getElementById("pvCatDirecciones").checked?"":"none";
}
function pvApplyZoneRangeFilter(){pvApplyCombinedFilters(true)}
function pvToggleZoneCodeDropdown(){document.getElementById("pvZoneCodePanel").classList.toggle("open")}
function pvToggleAllZoneCodes(checked){
  document.querySelectorAll("#pvZoneCodeOptions input").forEach(cb=>cb.checked=checked);
  pvUpdateZoneCodeSelection();
}
function pvSelectedZoneCodes(){
  return[...document.querySelectorAll("#pvZoneCodeOptions input:checked")].map(cb=>cb.value);
}
function pvUpdateZoneCodeSelection(){
  const all=[...document.querySelectorAll("#pvZoneCodeOptions input")];
  const checked=pvSelectedZoneCodes();
  document.getElementById("pvZoneCodeAll").checked=all.length>0&&checked.length===all.length;
  const btn=document.getElementById("pvZoneCodeBtn");
  btn.textContent=checked.length===0?"Todas las zonas":checked.length===1?checked[0]:`${checked.length} zonas seleccionadas`;
  pvApplyCombinedFilters(true);
}
function pvApplyCombinedFilters(autoSelect){
  const gz=document.getElementById("pvZoneRangeSelect").value;
  const zcList=pvSelectedZoneCodes();
  document.querySelectorAll("#pvExportList .pv-export-item").forEach(el=>{
    const matchesGz=!gz||el.dataset.zone===gz;
    const matchesZc=zcList.length===0||zcList.includes(el.dataset.zonacode);
    const visible=matchesGz&&matchesZc;
    el.style.display=visible?"":"none";
    if(autoSelect&&(gz||zcList.length)){
      const cb=el.querySelector("input");
      if(cb)cb.checked=visible;
    }
  });
  document.querySelectorAll("#pvExportList .pv-export-zone-label").forEach(el=>{
    el.style.display=(!gz||el.dataset.zone===gz)?"":"none";
  });
  pvUpdateExportCount();
}
function pvFilterExportList(){
  const q=fold(document.getElementById("pvExportSearch").value);
  ["pvExportList","pvExportCorpList","pvExportCedisList","pvExportDireccionesList"].forEach(listId=>{
    document.querySelectorAll(`#${listId} .pv-export-item`).forEach(item=>{
      const txt=fold(item.textContent);
      item.style.display=txt.includes(q)?"":"none";
    });
  });
}
function pvSelectFilteredByText(){
  const q=fold(document.getElementById("pvExportSearch").value);
  if(!q){toast("Escribe algo para buscar primero");return}
  let count=0;
  const catMap={pvExportList:"pvCatSucursal",pvExportCorpList:"pvCatCorporativo",pvExportCedisList:"pvCatCedis",pvExportDireccionesList:"pvCatDirecciones"};
  Object.entries(catMap).forEach(([listId,catId])=>{
    let foundHere=0;
    document.querySelectorAll(`#${listId} .pv-export-item`).forEach(item=>{
      if(item.style.display!=="none"){
        const cb=item.querySelector("input");
        if(cb){cb.checked=true;count++;foundHere++}
      }
    });
    if(foundHere>0)document.getElementById(catId).checked=true;
  });
  pvToggleExportCategory();
  pvUpdateExportCount();
  toast(count?`${count} resultado${count===1?"":"s"} seleccionado${count===1?"":"s"}`:"Sin coincidencias");
}
function pvExportSelectAll(check){
  document.querySelectorAll("#pvExportList .pv-export-item:not([style*='display: none']) input").forEach(cb=>cb.checked=check);
  pvUpdateExportCount();
}
function pvExportSelectAllDept(cat,check){
  const id=cat==="corp"?"pvExportCorpList":cat==="cedis"?"pvExportCedisList":"pvExportDireccionesList";
  document.querySelectorAll(`#${id} input`).forEach(cb=>cb.checked=check);
}
function pvUpdateExportCount(){
  const n=document.querySelectorAll("#pvExportList input:checked, #pvExportCorpList input:checked, #pvExportCedisList input:checked, #pvExportDireccionesList input:checked").length;
  document.getElementById("pvExportCount").textContent=n?`${n} seleccionada${n===1?"":"s"}`:"";
}

function pvCoverTableSizeClass(rowCount){
  if(rowCount>35)return"pv-cover-table--xxs";
  if(rowCount>22)return"pv-cover-table--xs";
  if(rowCount>12)return"pv-cover-table--sm";
  return"";
}
function pvBuildStoreExportDoc(list,zoneTitle){
  const coverRows=list.map(({store,zoneManager})=>{
    const activeCount=records.filter(r=>r.location===store.location&&fold(r.status)==="activo").length;
    return `<tr><td>${safe(store.department||store.location)}</td><td>${safe(store.location)}</td><td>${safe(displayName(zoneManager))}</td><td>${safe(displayName(store))}</td><td style="text-align:right">${activeCount}</td></tr>`;
  }).join("");
  const totalActive=list.reduce((sum,{store})=>sum+records.filter(r=>r.location===store.location&&fold(r.status)==="activo").length,0);
  const coverHtml=`
    <div class="pv-store pv-store-break">
      <div class="pv-cover-page">
        <img class="pv-cover-logo" src="${PV_LOGO_SRC}" alt="JOMAR Autopartes">
        <div class="pv-cover-title">Organigramas que se exportan — Sucursales</div>
        ${zoneTitle?`<div class="pv-cover-zone">${safe(zoneTitle)}</div>`:""}
        <div class="pv-cover-sub">${list.length} sucursal${list.length===1?"":"es"} seleccionada${list.length===1?"":"s"} · ${new Date().toLocaleDateString("es-MX",{day:"numeric",month:"long",year:"numeric"})}</div>
        <table class="pv-cover-table ${pvCoverTableSizeClass(list.length)}">
          <thead><tr><th>Sucursal</th><th>Ubicación</th><th>Gerente de Zona</th><th>Gerente de Tienda</th><th style="text-align:right">Activos</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>${coverRows}</tbody>
        </table>
        <div class="pv-cover-total">Total de colaboradores activos: ${totalActive}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  const storesHtml=list.map(({store:sm},idx)=>{
    const{team,roleGroups}=pvStoreRoster(sm);
    const breakClass="pv-page-break-before";
    return `
    <div class="pv-store ${breakClass}">
      <div class="pv-store-page">
        <div class="pv-store-head">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px">
            <img class="pv-store-logo" src="${PV_LOGO_SRC}" alt="JOMAR Autopartes">
            <div>
              <div class="pv-store-title">${safe(sm.department||sm.location)}</div>
              <div class="pv-store-sub">Ubicación: ${safe(sm.location)} &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${team.length+1} personas totales</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-tree">
          <div class="pv-manager-row">
            <div class="pv-manager-card"><div class="role">${safe(sm.role)}</div><div class="name">${safe(displayName(sm))}</div>${pvHcVisible?`<div class="hc-line">${team.length+1}</div>`:""}</div>
          </div>
          <div class="pv-role-groups">
            ${roleGroups.length?roleGroups.map(g=>pvRenderRoleBox(g.role,g.list)).join(""):'<div class="pv-empty">Sin personal adicional registrado en esta sucursal.</div>'}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
  return coverHtml+storesHtml;
}

  const coverRows=items.map(d=>{

  }).join("");
  const totalActive=items.reduce((sum,d)=>sum+records.filter(r=>r.department===d.department&&fold(r.status)==="activo").length,0);
  const coverHtml=`
    <div class="pv-store pv-store-break">
      <div class="pv-cover-page">
        <img class="pv-cover-logo" src="${PV_LOGO_SRC}" alt="JOMAR Autopartes">
        <div class="pv-cover-title">Organigramas que se exportan — ${safe(label)}</div>
        <div class="pv-cover-sub">${items.length} departamento${items.length===1?"":"s"} seleccionado${items.length===1?"":"s"} · ${new Date().toLocaleDateString("es-MX",{day:"numeric",month:"long",year:"numeric"})}</div>
        <table class="pv-cover-table ${pvCoverTableSizeClass(items.length)}">
          <thead><tr><th>Departamento</th><th>Ubicación</th><th>Responsable</th><th style="text-align:right">Activos</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>${coverRows}</tbody>
        </table>
        <div class="pv-cover-total">Total de colaboradores activos: ${totalActive}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  const deptHtml=items.map((d,idx)=>{
    const kids=(childrenById.get(d.positionId)||[]);
    const total=1+(descendantCounts.get(d.positionId)||0);
    const breakClass="pv-page-break-before";
    return `
    <div class="pv-store ${breakClass}">
      <div class="pv-store-page">
        <div class="pv-store-head">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px">
            <img class="pv-store-logo" src="${PV_LOGO_SRC}" alt="JOMAR Autopartes">
            <div>
              <div class="pv-store-title">${safe(d.role||d.department)}</div>
              <div class="pv-store-sub">Ubicación: ${safe(d.location)} &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${total} personas totales</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-tree">
          <div class="pv-manager-row">
            <div class="pv-manager-card"><div class="role">${safe(d.role)}</div><div class="name">${safe(displayName(d))}</div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="pv-role-groups">
            ${kids.length?kids.map(k=>pvRenderRoleBox(k.role,[k])).join(""):'<div class="pv-empty">Sin reportes directos registrados.</div>'}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }).join("");
  return coverHtml+deptHtml;
}

function pvComputeSelectionTitle(kind,itemsList){
  if(kind==="store"){
    const zones=[...new Set(itemsList.map(({store})=>store.zone).filter(Boolean))];
    if(zones.length===1)return zones[0];
    const interiorNums=zones.map(z=>{const m=/^Z(\d+)\s*-\s*Interior$/i.exec(z||"");return m?m[1]:null});
    if(zones.length>1&&interiorNums.every(Boolean))return`Interior ${interiorNums.join(",")}`;
    return zones.length>1?"Sucursales Varios":"Sucursales";
  }
  if(itemsList.length===1)return safe(itemsList[0].department||itemsList[0].role||kind);
  return`${kind} Varios`;
}
function pvGenerateExport(){
  const jobs=[];
  if(document.getElementById("pvCatSucursal").checked){
    const ids=[...document.querySelectorAll("#pvExportList input:checked")].map(cb=>cb.value);
    if(ids.length){const list=pvAllStoresWithZone().filter(({store})=>ids.includes(store.positionId));const title=pvComputeSelectionTitle("store",list);jobs.push({label:"Sucursales",title,html:pvBuildStoreExportDoc(list,title)})}
  }
  if(document.getElementById("pvCatCorporativo").checked){
    const ids=[...document.querySelectorAll("#pvExportCorpList input:checked")].map(cb=>cb.value);
    if(ids.length){const items=ids.map(id=>byId.get(id)).filter(Boolean);jobs.push({label:"Corporativo",title:pvComputeSelectionTitle("Corporativo",items),html:pvBuildDeptExportDoc(items,"Corporativo")})}
  }
  if(document.getElementById("pvCatCedis").checked){
    const ids=[...document.querySelectorAll("#pvExportCedisList input:checked")].map(cb=>cb.value);
    if(ids.length){const items=ids.map(id=>byId.get(id)).filter(Boolean);jobs.push({label:"CEDIS",title:pvComputeSelectionTitle("CEDIS",items),html:pvBuildDeptExportDoc(items,"CEDIS")})}
  }
  if(document.getElementById("pvCatDirecciones").checked){
    const keys=[...document.querySelectorAll("#pvExportDireccionesList input:checked")].map(cb=>cb.value);
    const groups=pvAllDireccionGroups();
    keys.forEach(key=>{
      const g=groups.find(gr=>gr.key===key);
      if(g)jobs.push({label:g.role,title:safe(g.role),html:pvBuildDireccionExportDoc(g.people,g.role)});
    });
  }
  if(!jobs.length){toast("Selecciona al menos una sucursal o departamento");return}
  pvCloseExportModal();
  pvRunExportQueue(jobs,0);
}
function pvRunExportQueue(jobs,idx){
  if(idx>=jobs.length){document.title=pvOriginalTitle||document.title;toast("Exportación completa");return}
  if(!window.pvOriginalTitle)window.pvOriginalTitle=document.title;
  const job=jobs[idx];
  document.title=`${job.title}_ Organigrama Organizacional`;
  const box=document.getElementById("pvStoreBox");
  document.getElementById("pvStoreSelect").value="";
  box.innerHTML=`<div style="text-align:right;padding:0 0 14px"><button class="pv-print-btn" onclick="pvPrintStore()">🖨️ Imprimir / Guardar PDF</button></div>`+job.html;
  box.scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});
  toast(`PDF ${idx+1} de ${jobs.length}: ${job.label} — usa el botón de imprimir para guardarlo`);
  const onAfterPrint=()=>{
    window.removeEventListener("afterprint",onAfterPrint);
    if(idx+1<jobs.length)setTimeout(()=>pvRunExportQueue(jobs,idx+1),400);
    else document.title=pvOriginalTitle||document.title;
  };
  window.addEventListener("afterprint",onAfterPrint);
}

function pvBuildDireccionExportDoc(peopleArr,label){
  const groups=pvDireccionDeptGroups(peopleArr);
  const totalPeople=peopleArr.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+1+(descendantCounts.get(p.positionId)||0),0);
  return `
    <div class="pv-store">
      <div class="pv-store-page">
        <div class="pv-store-head">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px">
            <img class="pv-store-logo" src="${PV_LOGO_SRC}" alt="JOMAR Autopartes">
            <div>
              <div class="pv-store-title">${safe(label)}</div>
              <div class="pv-store-sub">${peopleArr.map(p=>safe(displayName(p))).join(" · ")} &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${totalPeople} personas totales</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-tree">
          <div class="pv-manager-row">
            ${peopleArr.map(p=>`<div class="pv-manager-card"><div class="role">${safe(ROLE_TITLE_OVERRIDES[p.positionId]||p.role)}</div><div class="name">${safe(displayName(p))}</div></div>`).join("")}
          </div>
          <div class="pv-role-groups">
            ${groups.length?groups.map(g=>`
              <div class="pv-role-box">
                <div class="head" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('collapsed')"><span>${safe(g.department)} (${g.total})</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
                <div style="padding:6px 14px 10px">${g.roleGroups.map(rg=>pvRenderRoleBox(rg.role,rg.list)).join("")}</div>
              </div>`).join(""):'<div class="pv-empty">Sin personal adicional registrado en esta dirección.</div>'}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
}
function pvDireccionDeptGroups(peopleArr){
  const rootIds=new Set(peopleArr.map(p=>p.positionId));
  const all=[];
  peopleArr.forEach(p=>descendantsOf(p.positionId).forEach(id=>{const r=byId.get(id);if(r&&!rootIds.has(r.positionId))all.push(r)}));
  const depts=new Map();
  all.forEach(r=>{const key=r.department||r.role||"(Sin departamento)";if(!depts.has(key))depts.set(key,[]);depts.get(key).push(r)});
  return[...depts.entries()].map(([dept,list])=>{
    const roleGroups=new Map();
    list.forEach(r=>{const k=r.role||"Sin puesto";if(!roleGroups.has(k))roleGroups.set(k,[]);roleGroups.get(k).push(r)});
    return{department:dept,total:list.length,roleGroups:[...roleGroups.entries()].map(([role,l])=>({role,list:l}))};
  }).sort((a,b)=>a.department.localeCompare(b.department,"es"));
}
function pvRenderDireccionGeneral(peopleArr){
  const box=document.getElementById("pvStoreBox");
  const groups=pvDireccionDeptGroups(peopleArr);
  const totalPeople=peopleArr.reduce((sum,p)=>sum+1+(descendantCounts.get(p.positionId)||0),0);
  box.innerHTML=`
    <div class="pv-store">
      <div class="pv-store-page">
        <div class="pv-store-head">
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px">
            <img class="pv-store-logo" src="${PV_LOGO_SRC}" alt="JOMAR Autopartes">
            <div>
              <div class="pv-store-title">${safe(peopleArr[0].role||peopleArr[0].department||"Dirección")}</div>
              <div class="pv-store-sub">${peopleArr.map(p=>safe(displayName(p))).join(" · ")} &nbsp;·&nbsp; ${totalPeople} personas totales</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button class="pv-print-btn" onclick="pvPrintStore()">🖨️ Imprimir / Guardar PDF</button>
        </div>
        <div class="pv-tree">
          <div class="pv-manager-row">
            ${peopleArr.map(p=>`<div class="pv-manager-card"><div class="role">${safe(ROLE_TITLE_OVERRIDES[p.positionId]||p.role)}</div><div class="name">${safe(displayName(p))}</div></div>`).join("")}
          </div>
          <div class="pv-role-groups">
            ${groups.length?groups.map(g=>`
              <div class="pv-role-box">
                <div class="head" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('collapsed')"><span>${safe(g.department)} (${g.total})</span><span class="chev">▾</span></div>
                <div style="padding:6px 14px 10px">${g.roleGroups.map(rg=>pvRenderRoleBox(rg.role,rg.list)).join("")}</div>
              </div>`).join(""):'<div class="pv-empty">Sin personal adicional registrado en esta dirección.</div>'}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
}
function pvAllDireccionGroups(){
  const direccionesRaw=(childrenById.get(DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID)||[]).filter(r=>fold(r.role||"").includes("director")||fold(r.role||"").includes("direccion"));
  const direccionGroups=[];
  const groupByRole=new Map();
  direccionesRaw.forEach(r=>{
    const key=fold(r.role||"");
    if(groupByRole.has(key))groupByRole.get(key).push(r);
    else{const g=[r];groupByRole.set(key,g);direccionGroups.push({role:r.role,people:g})}
  });
  const dgRecord=byId.get(DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID);
  if(dgRecord)direccionGroups.unshift({role:ROLE_TITLE_OVERRIDES[dgRecord.positionId]||dgRecord.role||"DIRECCIÓN GENERAL",people:[dgRecord]});
  return direccionGroups.map(g=>({...g,key:g.people.map(p=>p.positionId).join(",")}));
}
function pvDireccionesForExport(){return pvAllDireccionGroups()}
function renderPrintView(){
  const content=document.getElementById("pvContent");
  const director=pvVentasDirector();
  if(!director){content.innerHTML=`<div class="pv-empty">No se encontró la Dirección de Ventas en los datos actuales.</div>`;return}
  const direccionGroups=pvAllDireccionGroups();
  const groupKey=g=>g.key;
  if(!window.pvSelectedDireccionKey||!direccionGroups.some(g=>groupKey(g)===window.pvSelectedDireccionKey))window.pvSelectedDireccionKey=groupKey({people:[director],key:director.positionId});
  const selectedGroup=direccionGroups.find(g=>groupKey(g)===window.pvSelectedDireccionKey)||{role:director.role,people:[director]};
  const isVentas=selectedGroup.people.some(p=>p.positionId===director.positionId);
  const directs=selectedGroup.people.flatMap(p=>childrenById.get(p.positionId)||[]);
  const zoneManagers=isVentas?descendantsOf(director.positionId).map(id=>byId.get(id)).filter(Boolean).filter(pvIsZoneManager):[];

  content.innerHTML=`
    <div class="pv-head">
      <div class="pv-field" style="max-width:420px;margin-bottom:14px">
        <label for="pvDireccionSelect">Dirección</label>
        <select id="pvDireccionSelect">${direccionGroups.map(g=>`<option value="${groupKey(g)}" ${groupKey(g)===window.pvSelectedDireccionKey?"selected":""}>${safe(g.role||"Dirección")}</option>`).join("")}</select>
      </div>
      <p class="eyebrow-pv">${safe(selectedGroup.role||"Dirección")}</p>
      <h2>${safe((selectedGroup.role||"DIRECCIÓN").toUpperCase())}</h2>
      <div class="director-line">${selectedGroup.people.length>1?"Directores":"Director"}: <b>${selectedGroup.people.map(p=>safe(displayName(p))).join(" · ")}</b></div>
      <p class="pv-label">${directs.length?"Reportes Directos":"Sin reportes directos — vista general de la compañía"}</p>
      <div class="pv-cards">${directs.length?directs.map(pvCardHtml).join(""):(childrenById.get(DIRECTOR_GENERAL_ID)||[]).map(pvCardHtml).join("")}</div>
    </div>

    <div class="pv-controls" ${isVentas?"":'style="display:none"'}>
      <div class="pv-field">
        <label for="pvZoneSelect">Gerente de Zona</label>
        <select id="pvZoneSelect"></select>
      </div>
      <div class="pv-field" id="pvStoreFieldWrap">
        <label for="pvStoreSelect">Sucursal</label>
        <select id="pvStoreSelect"></select>
      </div>
      <div class="pv-field pv-search-field">
        <label for="pvStoreSearch">Buscar sucursal directo</label>
        <select id="pvStoreSearch"></select>
      </div>
      <div class="pv-field pv-search-field">
        <label for="pvTerritorialSearch">Buscar Territorial</label>
        <select id="pvTerritorialSearch"></select>
      </div>
      <div class="pv-actions">
        <button class="secondary-btn" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:0 14px" id="pvVerTodoBtn" onclick="pvRenderAllStores()">Ver todo</button>
        <button class="secondary-btn" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:0 14px" onclick="pvExpandAll(true)">Contraer todo</button>
        <button class="secondary-btn" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:0 14px" id="pvHcBtn" onclick="pvToggleHc()">HC</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pv-controls">
      <div class="pv-actions" style="margin:0">
        <button class="secondary-btn" style="width:auto;margin:0;padding:0 14px" onclick="pvOpenExportModal()">Exportar varias…</button>
        <label class="include-vacantes-label"><input type="checkbox" class="include-vacantes-toggle" ${includeVacantes?"checked":""} onchange="toggleIncludeVacantes(this.checked)"> Incluir vacantes</label>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="pv-zone-block" id="pvZoneBlock"></div>
    <div id="pvStoreBox"></div>
  `;

  document.getElementById("pvDireccionSelect").addEventListener("change",e=>{
    window.pvSelectedDireccionKey=e.target.value;
    renderPrintView();
  });

  if(!isVentas){
    document.getElementById("pvZoneBlock").innerHTML="";
    pvRenderDireccionGeneral(selectedGroup.people);
    return;
  }

  const zoneSelect=document.getElementById("pvZoneSelect");
  if(!zoneManagers.length){
    zoneSelect.innerHTML=`<option value="">Sin Gerentes de Zona registrados</option>`;
    document.getElementById("pvZoneBlock").innerHTML="";
    document.getElementById("pvStoreBox").innerHTML=`<div class="pv-empty">No se encontraron Gerentes de Zona bajo esta Dirección.</div>`;
    return;
  }
  zoneManagers.forEach(z=>{
    const opt=document.createElement("option");
    opt.value=z.positionId;
    opt.textContent=safe(displayName(z));
    zoneSelect.appendChild(opt);
  });
  zoneSelect.addEventListener("change",()=>pvRenderZone(zoneSelect.value));
  document.getElementById("pvStoreSelect").addEventListener("change",e=>{
    if(!e.target.value){document.getElementById("pvStoreBox").innerHTML=`<div class="pv-empty">Selecciona una sucursal arriba para ver su organigrama completo.</div>`;return}
    pvRenderStore(e.target.value);
  });

  // Buscador directo de sucursal: siempre disponible, no depende de elegir primero un Gerente de Zona
  const allStores=descendantsOf(director.positionId).map(id=>byId.get(id)).filter(Boolean).filter(pvIsStoreManager).sort((a,b)=>(a.department||a.location).localeCompare(b.department||b.location,"es"));
  const storeSearch=document.getElementById("pvStoreSearch");
  const searchPlaceholder=document.createElement("option");
  searchPlaceholder.value="";searchPlaceholder.textContent="Selecciona una sucursal…";
  storeSearch.appendChild(searchPlaceholder);
  allStores.forEach(s=>{
    const opt=document.createElement("option");
    opt.value=s.positionId;
    opt.textContent=`${s.department||s.location} (${s.location}) — ${safe(displayName(s))}`;
    storeSearch.appendChild(opt);
  });
  storeSearch.addEventListener("change",e=>{
    if(!e.target.value)return;
    const store=byId.get(e.target.value);if(!store)return;
    const zoneAncestor=zoneManagers.find(z=>descendantsOf(z.positionId).includes(store.positionId));
    if(zoneAncestor){zoneSelect.value=zoneAncestor.positionId;pvRenderZone(zoneAncestor.positionId)}
    const storeSelectEl=document.getElementById("pvStoreSelect");
    storeSelectEl.value=store.positionId;
    pvRenderStore(store.positionId);
  });

  // Buscador directo de Gerente Territorial
  const territorials=descendantsOf(director.positionId).map(id=>byId.get(id)).filter(Boolean).filter(r=>fold(r.role||"").includes("territorial")).sort((a,b)=>displayName(a).localeCompare(displayName(b),"es"));
  const terrSearch=document.getElementById("pvTerritorialSearch");
  const terrPlaceholder=document.createElement("option");
  terrPlaceholder.value="";terrPlaceholder.textContent=territorials.length?"Selecciona un Territorial…":"Sin Territoriales registrados";
  terrSearch.appendChild(terrPlaceholder);
  territorials.forEach(t=>{
    const opt=document.createElement("option");
    opt.value=t.positionId;
    opt.textContent=safe(displayName(t));
    terrSearch.appendChild(opt);
  });
  terrSearch.addEventListener("change",e=>{
    if(!e.target.value)return;
    showTab("org");
    focusOn(e.target.value);
  });

  pvRenderZone(zoneManagers[0].positionId);
}

try{
  rhRestoreSession();
  applyVisibility();rebuildIndex();
  setupSearch();loadEmbeddedWorkbook();draw({fit:true});if(typeof renderPrintView==="function")renderPrintView();loadRemoteExcel();
}catch(bootError){
  console.error("Error al iniciar el organigrama:",bootError);
  const shell=document.getElementById("canvasShell");
  if(shell){
    const box=document.createElement("div");
    box.style.cssText="position:absolute;top:40%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:#fff;border:2px solid #e5233f;border-radius:12px;padding:20px 26px;max-width:520px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.15);font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;z-index:50";
    box.innerHTML="<h3 style='margin:0 0 8px;color:#e5233f'>No se pudo iniciar el organigrama</h3><p style='margin:0 0 6px;font-size:13px;color:#333'>Ocurrió un error técnico al cargar los datos. Presiona F12, ve a la pestaña Console, y comparte el mensaje en rojo con soporte.</p><p style='margin:0;font-size:11px;color:#888;font-family:monospace'>"+(bootError&&bootError.message?bootError.message:String(bootError))+"</p>";
    shell.appendChild(box);
  }
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
